fields.title: Abasajja b’Okusaba
fields.description: Abasajja b’Okusaba: Amaloboozi Kkumi na Bataano Agaakyusa Ensi kikoowoola abasumba, abasomesa, n’abakulembeze b’Ekikristaayo wonna okuddayo mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’amaanyi. Okuyita mu bulamu bw’abasajja kkumi na bataano essaala zaabwe ezaabumba ebyafaayo, ekitabo kino kiraga engeri Katonda gy’akolera mu kwegayirira okw’obwetoowaze era okutakoowa.

qa.question: Abasajja b’Okusaba kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kikuŋŋaanya obulamu bw’abasajja kkumi na bataano essaala zaabwe ezaabumba ebyafaayo, nga kikoowoola abasumba, abasomesa, n’abakulembeze b’Ekikristaayo okuddayo mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’amaanyi. Okuyita mu byafaayo byabwe, ekitabo kiraga engeri Katonda gy’abadde akolera mu kwegayirira okw’obwetoowaze era okutakoowa, era kikubiriza omusomi okuddamu okufuula okusaba ensulo ekwekeddwa ey’obuweereza bwonna obubala ebibala n’obuyinza obw’omwoyo.

qa.question: Obubaka obukulu obw’ekitabo kino bwe buliwa?
qa.answer: Nti omulimu omunene ogw’omukulembeze yenna Omukristaayo gusooka kukolerwa mu kyama, ng’afukamidde — nti Katonda abumba ebyafaayo ng’ayita mu basajja abasaba, so si mu balina ebirabo oba amaanyi. Nga kiraga ebyokulabirako kkumi na bitaano, ekitabo kiraga nti okusaba ye yingini ya ddala ey’amaanyi ag’omwoyo, era kikoowoola omusomi okuddayo mu kifo eky’ekyama amaanyi ago mwe gava.

qa.question: ‘Amaloboozi kkumi na bataano’ kwe kyesigamye be baani?
qa.answer: Ekitabo kikuŋŋaanya abasajja kkumi na bataano okuva mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa obulamu bwabwe obwali bulabikiramu okusaba okw’ekitalo — abeegayirizi abaasaba mu kyama ne kubala ebibala ebirabika mu kuzuukuka, mu buminsani, ne mu buweereza. Mu kifo ky’okuwolereza okusaba mu bigambo obugambo, kireka obulamu buno kkumi na butaano bwe bulaga ensonga, nga kiggya mu buli bumu eby’okuyiga eby’obulamu obwaweebwayo eri okwegayirira.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kyawandiikirwa ani?
qa.answer: Okusingira ddala abasumba, abasomesa, n’abakulembeze b’Ekikristaayo, naye ne buli mukkiriza awulira nti obuweereza bwe oba obulamu bwe bubulamu amaanyi ag’omwoyo. Ekitabo kikoowoola okuddayo mu kifo eky’ekyama, era kyogera eri buli eyeesiga obusobozi, emirimu, oba enkola mu kifo ky’okusaba, nga kibakoowoola eri omulimu ogukwekeddwa ogw’okwegayirira.

qa.question: Lwaki essira kuteekebwa ku bulamu bw’abasajja abaasabanga mu kifo ky’okuyigiriza ku kusaba?
qa.answer: Kubanga ekyokulabirako kiyigiriza ekyo empaka zokka kye zitayinza. Bwe kiraga abasajja essaala zaabwe ezaabumba ebyafaayo mu lwatu, ekitabo kifuula okusaba okwa ddala era okusikiriza, era kikubiriza omusomi si kutegeera bukulu bwakwo kwokka wabula n’okukukoppa. Obulamu bwabwe bukakasa ekyo okuyigiriza kye kugamba — nti Katonda akola n’amaanyi mangi ng’ayita mu abo abasaba.

qa.question: Ekitabo kigamba nti kiki ekyafuula abasajja bano ab’amaanyi?
qa.answer: Si bugagga, si kifo, wadde ebirabo eby’obuzaaliranwa, wabula okusaba okw’obwetoowaze era okutakoowa. Eky’okuyiga ekitabo ky’eddiŋŋana kiri nti abasajja bano baasookanga okunyeenya ebintu mu nsi etalabika, era nti omugaso gwabwe mu lwatu gwava mu kwegayirira kwabwe okw’ekyama — bwe kityo ekyama ky’obuyinza bwabwe kisobola okufunibwa buli mukkiriza eyeetegefu okusaba nga bo bwe baasaba.

qa.question: Kino kikwatagana kitya n’ekitabo ekikigoberera ‘Men Who Moved Heaven’?
qa.answer: Ebitabo bino byombi bigenda wamu era bifaanagana mu nsonga, byombi nga biraga abasajja essaala zaabwe ezaakyusa enkulungo y’ebintu. Abasajja b’Okusaba kiraga abasajja baakyo kkumi na bataano ng’okukoowoola abakulembeze okuddayo mu kifo eky’ekyama; Men Who Moved Heaven kinyweza amazima ago gamu nti ebyafaayo bikyusibwa okwegayirira so si maanyi ga ku nsi, era ebitabo byombi binywezagana.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanidde kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, oba ku bulamu bwonna obumusikiriza, kubanga buli ssuula eyimirira yokka mu bungi — naye ekitabo kigendereddwa kusomebwa ng’okukoowoola okutakoma okuddayo mu kusaba. Nga butwaliddwa wamu, obulamu buno kkumi na butaano bukola okukoowoola okugenda kweyongera okuddayo mu kifo eky’ekyama, okusinga okusomebwa mu kusaba ne kufuulibwa obulamu obuzzibwa obuggya obw’okwegayirira.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Omuliro Ogutalina Kuzikira

Okusaba gwe mutima ogukuba ogw’Ekkanisa. Buli Katonda gy’akoze n’amaanyi mu byafaayo — buli Enjiri gy’emenye ettaka ekkakanyavu, buli okuzuukuka gye kwayita mu mawanga, buli ekizikiza gye kyadda emabega mu maaso g’ekitangaala kya Kristo — wabaddewo ekibinja ky’abasajja n’abakazi abaagaana okulekera awo okusaba. Baasabanga mu matulutulu ng’amaka gaabwe tegannazuukuka. Baasabanga ekiro kyonna ng’amagye gatiisa era ng’amawanga gali ku bunkenke. Baasabiranga abaabula, abalwadde, abamenyese, ekkanisa, n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Era Katonda yaddamu.

Ekitabo kino kyogera ku basajja kkumi na bataano ab’engeri eyo. Baabeerawo mu byasa bina, ku ssemazinga ttaano, era mu nnono nnyingi ez’Obukristaayo ez’enjawulo. Abamu baali bayivu; abalala tebaasoma nnyo. Abamu baali basumba b’ebibiina ebinene mu bibuga ebimanyiddwa; abalala baaweereza nga tebamanyiddwa, ebisibo ebitono mu bifo eby’ewala. Abamu bamanyiddwa nnyo mu nsi yonna; abalala bamanyiddwa okusinga abo abanoonya ebyokulabirako ebinene eby’okusaba. Naye bonna balina ekintu kimu kye bafaanaganya: baali basajja abasaba, era olw’okuba baasaba, ensi yakyuka.

Lwaki Ekitabo Kino kya Basumba

Ekkanisa erina obusika obw’ekitalo obw’okusaba mu buli nsi. Abajulizi ba Uganda — abavubuka abo abaafiirira Kristo mu 1886 mu kifo ky’okwegaana Mukama waabwe — baassaako Ekkanisa ya Uganda akabonero n’omusaayi gw’abatukuvu. Okuzuukuka okw’Obuvanjuba bwa Afirika mu myaka gya 1930 ne 1940 kwakyusa obulamu bw’enkumi n’enkumi mu kitundu, era ebibala byakwo bikyalabika ne leero.

Buli w’oweereza, Katonda yasimba abajulirwa b’okusaba mu maaso go.

Naye buli mulembe gulina okuzuula okusaba ku lwagwo. Tekimala kusikira ssaala z’abo abaatukulembera. Buli musumba, mukadde, musomesa, n’omukulembeze w’ekkanisa alina okujja mu maaso ga Katonda mu linnya lye ye, n’emigugu gye ye, ayige okusaba n’eddoboozi lye ye. Omuliro ku kyoto gulina okukuumibwa nga gwaka. Gulina okuliisibwa enku empya buli ku makya.

Ekitabo kino kiwandiikiddwa olw’abasumba n’abasomesa kubanga obuvunaanyizibwa bw’omusumba bwa njawulo. Weetikka omugugu gw’ekibiina kyo ku bibegabega byo. Obuulira ku Ssande, obudaabuda abakungubaga, okyalira abalwadde, otendeka abakkiriza abato, era okulembera ekkanisa yo mu kusinza. Osanga okuziyizibwa, okuggwaamu amaanyi, obwavu, era oluusi n’okulyamu olukwe. Weetaaga amaanyi g’okusaba okusinga omuntu yenna mu kitundu kyo. Bw’otosaba, ebigambo byo bifuuka bya bwereere, okubuulirira kwo kufuuka magezi gokka, n’obuweereza bwo bufuuka mirimu gyokka. Naye bw’osaba — bw’oyiga okusisinkana Katonda mu kifo eky’ekyama buli lunaku — olwo buli ky’okola kijja kubeera n’obuzito bw’eggulu.

Ku Basajja Bano Ekkumi n’Abataano

Abasajja ekkumi n’abataano mu kitabo kino baalondebwa kubanga balaga obugazi bwonna obw’okusaba bwe bufaanana mu bulamu obwewaddeyo. Mu bo mulimu: • Andrew Murray — omusumba wa Dutch Reformed ow’e South Africa eyawandiika ebitabo ebisoba mu 200 ku bulamu obw’omunda ennyo n’okusaba • Charles Spurgeon — Omulangira w’Ababuulizi, Metropolitan Tabernacle ye yazimbibwa era n’ekuumibwa mu kusaba • Watchman Nee — omusimbi w’amakanisa Omuchina eyamala emyaka amakumi abiri egy’enkomerero mu kkomera ly’Abakomunisiti olw’okukkiriza kwe • D. L. Moody — omutunzi w’engatto atasoma eyafuuka omubuulizi w’enjiri asinga obukulu mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda • R. A. Torrey — eyaddira Moody mu bigere, ekitabo kye Engeri y’Okusaba kikyali kimu ku biragiro ebisinga okuyamba ku kusaba • E. M. Bounds — eyasabanga okuva ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro okutuuka ku ssaawa emu ez’oku makya buli lunaku, era ebitabo bye musanvu ku munaana ku kusaba byafulumizibwa ng’amaze okufa • Jonathan Edwards — omukugu mu by’eddiini Omupulitaani ennaabuulira ze n’essaala ze ebyayamba okukoleeza Okuzuukuka Okunene Okusooka mu Amerika • Charles Finney — puliida eyafuuka omukunzi w’okuzuukuka, obuweereza bwe obwajjula okusaba bwalaba abantu abasoba mu kitundu kya kakadde nga bajja eri Kristo • Rees Howells — omwegayirizi Omuwelisi, ekibinja kye eky’okusaba kitwalibwa okuba nti kyakyusa embeera y’Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri olw’okwegayirira • Billy Graham — eyabuulira Enjiri eri abantu bangi amaaso ku maaso okusinga omuntu yenna mu byafaayo • Henry Blackaby — ekitabo kye Okulaba Katonda ng’Akola kiyigirizza obukadde n’obukadde okuwulira n’okugondera eddoboozi lya Katonda mu kusaba • Bill Bright — eyatandikawo Campus Crusade for Christ, era firimu ye eya Yesu yakalabibwa abantu abasoba mu buwumbi butaano • Loren Cunningham — omutandisi wa Youth With A Mission, eyafuna okwolesebwa kwe kwonna okw’okubuulira ensi yonna enjiri ng’ayita mu kusaba • Derek Prince — omuyivu w’e Cambridge eyakyuka ng’asoma Bayibuli yekka mu nkambi y’amagye, n’amala emyaka nkaaga ng’ayigiriza ku kusaba n’olutalo olw’omwoyo • Timothy Keller — omusumba eyatandikawo Redeemer Presbyterian Church mu Manhattan n’ayamba ekkanisa y’ensi yonna okutegeera okusaba ng’okutya okw’ekitiibwa, okwesemberera, n’okusisinkana Katonda omulamu Engeri Ekitabo Kino gye Kitegekeddwamu Buli ssuula eyogera ku musajja omu. Ojja kusangamu: 1. Ebyafaayo ebimpi — gwe yali, gye yava, ne bye yatuukiriza 2. Okuddibwamu okw’amaanyi okw’essaala mu bulamu bwe — emboozi entongole eraga nti Katonda ddala awulira era addamu 3. Ebyawandiikibwa ebikulu — ebitundu bya Bayibuli bibiri oba bisatu ebikwatagana n’obulamu bwe n’okuyigiriza kwe ku kusaba 4. Ebigambo bye ku kusaba — ebigambo bitaano eby’amaanyi ebiraga engeri gye yategeeramu era gye yakolamu okusaba 5. Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda — engeri gye yagattamu okusaba n’Ebyawandiikibwa 6. Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu — engeri gye yategeeramu omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu kusaba Ekigambo Nga Tonnatandika Ekitabo kino kyategekebwa okukozesebwa, so si kusomebwa kyokka. Buli ssuula esobola okuba omusingi gw’olunaku lw’okwesomesa ggwe kennyini, olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba, okubuulira, okwewummuza kw’abasumba, oba okufuula abantu abayigirizwa.

Ebigambo ebijuliziddwa bisaanira okubuulira. Ebyafaayo n’essaala ezaddibwamu bisaanira okuyigiriza. Ebyawandiikibwa binyweza buli kimu mu Kigambo kya Katonda.

Toyanguyiriza kitabo kino. Tuula ne buli musajja okumala akaseera. Leka obulamu bwe bukusoomooze. Leka ebigambo bye bikoleeze enjala yo. Leka essaala ye eyaddibwamu ezimbe okukkiriza kwo. Olwo genda osabe.

Nga Andrew Murray bwe yawandiika: “Omuntu akunga ekkanisa ey’Ekikristaayo okusaba ajja kuwaayo ekirabo ekisinga obunene eri okubuulira ensi yonna enjiri mu byafaayo.” Ekkanisa yeetaaga abasajja n’abakazi ab’engeri eyo. Oboolyawo naawe oli omu ku bo.

Soma. Omutima gwo gukoleezebwe. Saba. Kyusa ensi.

fields.title: Andrew Murray (1828 – 1917)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Andrew Murray yazaalibwa nga 9 Mayi 1828 e Graaff Reinet, mu South Africa, mutabani w’omuminsani w’Ekkanisa ya Dutch Reformed eyava e Scotland. Bwe yali wa myaka kkumi, ye ne muganda we John baasindikibwa e Scotland okusoma, gye baakwatibwako ennyo ababuulizi b’okuzuukuka nga William Burns. Oluvannyuma baasoma eby’eddiini ku University of Utrecht mu Holland, gye baaziyiza endowooza ez’amagezi g’obuntu ez’omulembe ogwo, ne batandikawo ekibinja ekitono eky’okusaba ekyayitibwanga mu kunyooma “Chocolate Club.”

Bwe yatongozebwa mu 1848, Murray yaweebwa omulimu omunene ennyo ogw’okubeera omusumba yekka ku kitundu kya mayiro za square 50,000 mu South Africa ey’ewala. Okumala wiiki nnyingi yeebagalanga embalaasi okugenda okubuulira amaka g’abalimi aboogera Oludaaki abaali beesudde. Yawasa Emma Rutherford mu 1856 era bombi baazaala abaana munaana.

Murray yalabirira amakanisa e Bloemfontein, Worcester, Cape Town, ne Wellington mu buweereza bwe obuwanvu, era n’afuuka omuntu omukulu mu Kuzuukuka kwa South Africa okwa 1860. Yokaana 15:7 (OLCB) — “Naye bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.”

Abaruumi 8:26 (OLCB) — “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka.”

Mwekuumenga nga mugumiikirizanga, era nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu, be bantu bonna aba Katonda.”

“Okusaba si kujja bujja eri Katonda okumusaba ekintu. Okusinga byonna, kwe kussa ekimu ne Katonda n’okuleetebwa wansi w’amaanyi g’obutukuvu bwe n’okwagala kwe, okutuusa lw’atwefunira n’ateeka ku butonde bwaffe bwonna akabonero k’obwetoowaze bwa Kristo, nga kye kyama ky’okusinza kwonna okw’amazima.”

“Okusaba si kwogera kw’omu yekka, wabula kwogeraganya; eddoboozi lya Katonda kye kitundu kyakwo ekisinga obukulu. Okuwuliriza eddoboozi lya Katonda kye kyama ky’obukakafu nti naye ajja kuwuliriza eryange.”

“Ekiseera ekimala mu kusaba kijja kuvaamu ebisingawo okusinga ekyo ekiweebwa omulimu. Okusaba kwokka kwe kuwa omulimu omugaso gwagwo n’obuwanguzi bwagwo. Okusaba kuggulawo ekkubo Katonda yennyini akole omulimu gwe mu ffe era ng’ayita mu ffe.”

“Omwoyo Omutukuvu ajja ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba okw’okukkiriza. Ekigero ky’okusaba okw’okukkiriza okutaggwaawo kye kijja okuba ekigero ky’omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu Kkanisa.”

“Tewali kintu kibikkula bulamu bwa mwoyo obunafu mu muweereza oba mu kibiina okusinga obutabaamu kusaba okw’okukkiriza era okutakoma. Okusaba kwe kukuba kw’omusuwa ogw’obulamu obw’omwoyo. Kye kkubo ekkulu abaweereza n’abakkiriza aba bulijjo mwe bafunira omukisa n’amaanyi eby’eggulu.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Bangi tebategeera bumu buno obw’okuyigiriza kw’Ekigambo n’Omwoyo, kyova wabaawo obuzibu obw’emirundi ebiri mu kumanya Katonda by’ayagala. Ebyo byombi birina okugattibwa — Ekigambo n’Omwoyo — kubanga mu byo byokka mwe tusobola okumanya mu bukakafu Katonda by’ayagala, n’okuyiga okusaba okusinziira ku ebyo.”

“Okubeera omwetegefu okukkiriza buli kisuubizo awatali kubuusabuusa, okugondera buli kiragiro awatali kulwawo, okuyimirira nga tuli bajjuvu era nga tutuukiridde mu byonna Katonda by’ayagala, gwe mwoyo gwokka ogw’amazima ogw’okusoma Bayibuli.”

“Mu buli ssaala Katonda Omu mu Basatu yeetabamu — Kitaffe awulira, Omwana mu linnya lye tusabira, n’Omwoyo atusabira era asaba mu ffe. Nga kikulu nnyo ffe okubeera mu nkolagana entuufu n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu era tutegeere omulimu gwe!”

“Olw’Omwoyo we, Omwoyo w’okusaba, obulamu bwaffe busobola okubeera obw’okusaba obutakoma. Omwoyo w’okusaba ajja kukuyamba okufuuka omwegayirizi, ng’osaba Katonda ebintu ebinene ku lw’abo abakwetoolodde.”

“Obulamu obw’omwoyo bwe buba obulungi, wansi w’amaanyi amajjuvu ag’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okusaba obutakoma kujja kubeera kwa butonde.”

fields.title: Charles Spurgeon (1834 – 1892)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Charles Haddon Spurgeon yazaalibwa nga 19 Jjuuni 1834 e Kelvedon, Essex, mu Bungereza, mu maka g’ababuulizi — kitaawe ne jjajjaawe bombi baali basumba ba Congregationalist. Yakyuka mu ngeri ey’ekitalo ng’alina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, bwe yakwatibwa omuyaga ogw’omuzira n’ayingira mu kakanisa akatono aka Primitive Methodist, n’awulira omubuulizi owa bulijjo ng’ayogera ku Isaaya 45:22: “Mudde gye ndi, mulokoke, mmwe mwenna abali ku nkomerero z’ensi.” Obubaka obwangu bwafumita omutima gwe n’azaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.

Mu mwaka ogwo gwennyini yateekebwa ng’omusumba w’ekibiina ekitono ekya Baptist, era bwe yaweza emyaka amakumi abiri yali ayitiddwa mu New Park Street Chapel e London — emu ku makanisa ga Baptist agasinga obukulu mu ggwanga. Okubuulira kwe amangu ago kwasikiriza ebibiina binene nnyo. Ekkanisa yali ntono nnyo, era oluvannyuma lw’okusengukira mu bifo ebinene ebiwerako, Metropolitan Tabernacle yazimbibwa mu 1861 okutuuza abantu 6,000.

Spurgeon yabuulira abantu abateeberezebwa okuba obukadde kkumi mu bulamu bwe, yatendeka abasumba kumpi lwenda mu Pastors’ College ye, yatandikawo ennyumba y’abaana bamulekwa, era yawandiika nnyo — okubuulira kwe okwakuŋŋaanyizibwa kujjuza ebitabo nkaaga mu bisatu era kukyasomebwa ne leero. Mu bulijjo yabuuliranga emirundi ena mu wiiki era yamanya abammemba be 6,000 amannya gaabwe.

Wadde yalina obuweereza obw’ekitalo, Spurgeon yabonaabona nnyo n’endwadde ya gout, okwennyamira, n’ennaku y’okuwaayirizibwa bannaabwe abaweereza. Teyalekera awo kubuulira mu kubonaabona kwe, era bingi ku biwandiiko bye ebisinga obuziba ku kusaba byava mu biseera bye ebisinga okuba eby’ekizikiza. Yafiira e Menton, mu Bufalansa, nga 31 Janwali 1892, ng’alina emyaka 57, era akyatwalibwa nnyo ng’omubuulizi asinga obukulu mu biseera bino eby’omulembe.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Ku ntandikwa y’obuweereza bwe mu New Park Street Chapel, Spurgeon yayolekagana n’okusoomoozebwa okw’okukkiriza. Ekibiina kyali kitono era nga kikendeera. Yasaba n’obunyiikivu Katonda ajjuze ekkanisa emyoyo.

Mu myezi mitono nga yakatuuka, ekizimbe kyali kijjudde nga kiyiika, amakubo wakati w’entebe nga gakubyeko abantu, era enkumi n’enkumi nga ziyimiridde wabweru nga zigezaako okuwulira. Spurgeon yategeeza nti enkyukakyuka eno ey’ekitalo yali kuddibwamu kwa ssaala kwokka era mu bujjuvu.

Ekisinga n’obuziba, Spurgeon yayogeranga ku lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba ng’ekyuma ekivuga Metropolitan Tabernacle. Yagamba nti olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olwa Bbalaza akawungeezi — olwajjanga enkumi n’enkumi buli wiiki — lwe lwali ekyama ky’ebyo byonna Tabernacle bye yatuukiriza. Bwe baamubuuzanga ku maanyi g’obuweereza bwe, yatwalanga abagenyi wansi mu kisenge eky’omu ttaka, eyo gye basanga abantu ebikumi nga bafukamidde essaawa yonna. “Wano,” bwe yagamba, “we wali ekkolero ly’amaanyi.”

Emu ku mboozi ezisinga okumanyika mu buweereza bwa Spurgeon ekwata ku mukyala eyali agalamidde ku kitanda olw’obulwadde eyasoma ku nkuŋŋaana za D. L. Moody mu Amerika. Yatandika okusaba ddala Katonda asindike omubuulizi omukulu mu kkanisa ye yennyini e London. Nga tamanyi, Moody yatuuka mu Bungereza n’ayitibwa — omusumba w’ekibiina kye ddala — okubuulira. Ebyavaamu byali bya kitalo — abantu ebikumi nga bakkiriza mu lukuŋŋaana lumu. Spurgeon yakozesanga emboozi eno emirundi mingi okulaga amaanyi g’omuntu omu asaba.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Yeremiya 33:3 (OLCB) — “Mumpite n’abayitaba ne mbalaga ebikulu ebitanoonyezeka bye mutamanyi.”

Abaebbulaniya 4:16 (OLCB) — “Kale tusembererenga entebe ya Katonda ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa n’obuvumu, tufune okusaasirwa n’ekisa tubeerwe mu kwetaaga kwaffe.”

Matayo 21:22 (OLCB) — “Buli kye munaasabanga nga mukkiriza, munaakiweebwanga.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okusaba okw’amazima kupimibwa buzito, so si buwanvu. Okusinda okumu mu maaso ga Katonda kuyinza okubaamu obujjuvu bw’okusaba okusinga okwogera okulungi okuwanvu ennyo.”

“Okusaba gwe musuwa omutono ogutambuza ekinywa ky’obuyinza bwonna.”

“Amaanyi g’okusaba tegasobola kutenderezebwa kusukkiridde. Abo abatasobola kuweereza Katonda nga babuulira tebeetaaga kwejjusa. Omuntu bw’aba ng’asobola okusaba obusabi, asobola okukola buli kimu. Oyo amanyi okuwangula ne Katonda mu kusaba, eggulu n’ensi biri mu mikono gye.”

“Mu bufunze, okusaba si kirala wabula okutwala ebisuubizo bya Katonda gy’ali, n’okumugamba nti, “Kola nga bwe wayogera.” Okusaba kye kisuubizo ekikozeseddwa. Essaala etazimbiddwa ku kisuubizo terina musingi gwa mazima.”

“Mu kusaba, tuyimirira bamalayika we bavuunamira nga babisse amaaso gaabwe. Eyo, yee eyo, bakerubi ne baserafi basinziza mu maaso g’entebe eyo yennyini essaala zaffe gye zirinnya. Era tunajja eyo n’okusaba okutono n’okukkiriza okufunda era okukonziba?”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Buli lw’otategeera kyawandiikibwa, bikkula Bayibuli yo, fukamira, osabe ku kyawandiikibwa ekyo. Okusaba kye kisumuluzo ekiggulawo amawanika g’ebyama. Okusaba n’okukkiriza bisumuluzo ebitukuvu ebiyinza okubikkula ebyama n’okufuna eby’obugagga ebinene.”

“Omuntu asinga okusaba obulungi ye muntu amanyidde ennyo ebisuubizo bya Katonda mu kukkiriza. Mu bufunze, okusaba si kirala wabula okutwala ebisuubizo bya Katonda gy’ali, n’okumugamba nti, “Kola nga bwe wayogera.””

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Okusaba kitonde kya Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Tetuyinza kubeerawo awatali kusaba, era tetuyinza kusaba awatali Mwoyo Omutukuvu.”

“Singa oyinza okusaba essaala esinga obulungi mu nsi awatali Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Katonda teyandibadde na kakwate nayo. Naye essaala yo bw’eba emenyese, nga nnema era ng’ewenyera, bw’eba nga Omwoyo y’agikoze, Katonda ajja kugitunuulira agambe, nga bwe yagamba ku mirimu gy’okutonda, “Kirungi nnyo.””

Charles Haddon Spurgeon yazaalibwa nga 19 Jjuuni 1834 e Kelvedon, Essex, mu Bungereza, mu maka g’ababuulizi — kitaawe ne jjajjaawe bombi baali basumba ba Congregationalist. Yakyuka mu ngeri ey’ekitalo ng’alina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, bwe yakwatibwa omuyaga ogw’omuzira n’ayingira mu kakanisa akatono aka Primitive Methodist, n’awulira omubuulizi owa bulijjo ng’ayogera ku Isaaya 45:22: “Mudde gye ndi, mulokoke, mmwe mwenna abali ku nkomerero z’ensi.” Obubaka obwangu bwafumita omutima gwe n’azaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Mu mwaka ogwo gwennyini yateekebwa ng’omusumba w’ekibiina ekitono ekya Baptist, era bwe yaweza emyaka amakumi abiri yali ayitiddwa mu New Park Street Chapel e London — emu ku makanisa ga Baptist agasinga obukulu mu ggwanga. Okubuulira kwe amangu ago kwasikiriza ebibiina binene nnyo. Ekkanisa yali ntono nnyo, era oluvannyuma lw’okusengukira mu bifo ebinene ebiwerako, Metropolitan Tabernacle yazimbibwa mu 1861 okutuuza abantu 6,000. Spurgeon yabuulira abantu abateeberezebwa okuba obukadde kkumi mu bulamu bwe, yatendeka abasumba kumpi lwenda mu Pastors’ College ye, yatandikawo ennyumba y’abaana bamulekwa, era yawandiika nnyo — okubuulira kwe okwakuŋŋaanyizibwa kujjuza ebitabo nkaaga mu bisatu era kukyasomebwa ne leero. Mu bulijjo yabuuliranga emirundi ena mu wiiki era yamanya abammemba be 6,000 amannya gaabwe. Wadde yalina obuweereza obw’ekitalo, Spurgeon yabonaabona nnyo n’endwadde ya gout, okwennyamira, n’ennaku y’okuwaayirizibwa bannaabwe abaweereza. Teyalekera awo kubuulira mu kubonaabona kwe, era bingi ku biwandiiko bye ebisinga obuziba ku kusaba byava mu biseera bye ebisinga okuba eby’ekizikiza. Yafiira e Menton, mu Bufalansa, nga 31 Janwali 1892, ng’alina emyaka 57, era akyatwalibwa nnyo ng’omubuulizi asinga obukulu mu biseera bino eby’omulembe. Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu Ku ntandikwa y’obuweereza bwe mu New Park Street Chapel, Spurgeon yayolekagana n’okusoomoozebwa okw’okukkiriza. Ekibiina kyali kitono era nga kikendeera. Yasaba n’obunyiikivu Katonda ajjuze ekkanisa emyoyo. Mu myezi mitono nga yakatuuka, ekizimbe kyali kijjudde nga kiyiika, amakubo wakati w’entebe nga gakubyeko abantu, era enkumi n’enkumi nga ziyimiridde wabweru nga zigezaako okuwulira. Spurgeon yategeeza nti enkyukakyuka eno ey’ekitalo yali kuddibwamu kwa ssaala kwokka era mu bujjuvu. Bwe baamubuuzanga ku maanyi g’obuweereza bwe, yatwalanga abagenyi wansi mu kisenge eky’omu ttaka, eyo gye basanga abantu ebikumi nga bafukamidde essaawa yonna. “Wano,” bwe yagamba, “we wali ekkolero ly’amaanyi.” Emu ku mboozi ezisinga okumanyika mu buweereza bwa Spurgeon ekwata ku mukyala eyali agalamidde ku kitanda olw’obulwadde eyasoma ku nkuŋŋaana za D. fields.title: Watchman Nee (1903 – 1972)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Watchman Nee — erinnya lye ery’Oluchina nga ye Ni To-sheng, ekitegeeza “ekide ekivuga” — yazaalibwa e Foochow, mu China, mu 1903, mu maka ag’Abakristaayo ab’omulembe ogwokusatu. Jjajjaawe ye yali omusumba Omuchina eyasooka owa Congregationalist mu ssaza lya Fujian, ate nnyina yasaba okufuna omwana ow’obulenzi nga Watchman tannazaalibwa, n’asuubiza okumuwaayo eri Katonda. Yalokoka ng’alina emyaka kkumi na musanvu, mu 1920, ng’ayita mu buweereza bw’omubuulizi w’enjiri Dora Yu.

Mu myaka esatu nga yakakyuka, Watchman yali awandiika era afulumya magazini ez’eby’eddiini, ng’abuulira mu China yonna, era ng’asimba kye yayita “amakanisa ag’omu kitundu” — ebibiina ebisimbiddwa mu nkola y’Endagaano Empya era nga tebyesigamye ku nzimba z’amadiini ag’Ebugwanjuba. Okutuuka mu 1932, amakanisa gano ag’omu kitundu gaali gabunye mu China, Malaysia, Indonesia, ne Singapore.

Yafulumya ekitabo kye eky’ebitundu bisatu ekikulu Omuntu ow’Omwoyo mu 1928, n’ekitabo kye ekisinga okumanyika Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo Obwa Bulijjo — ekimu ku bitabo eby’edda ebikulu mu biwandiiko by’Ekikristaayo — kyasinziira ku mboozi ze yayogera mu Lungereza mu ngendo ze mu Bulaaya mu 1938 ne 1939.

Mu 1952, gavumenti y’Abakomunisiti yakwata Watchman Nee olw’okukkiriza kwe. Oluvannyuma lw’omusango omuwanvu, yasalirwa mu 1956 ekibonerezo ky’emyaka kkumi n’ettaano mu kkomera, naye teyateebwa n’akatono. Yamala emyaka amakumi abiri egy’enkomerero egy’obulamu bwe mu kkomera, era n’afiira eyo nga 30 Mayi 1972. Bwe yafa, akapapula akatono kaasangibwa wansi w’omutto gwe. Kaali kawandiikiddwako nti: “Kristo ye Mwana wa Katonda eyafa olw’okununula aboonoonyi era n’azuukira oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu. Gano ge mazima agasinga obukulu mu bwengula bwonna. Nfa olw’okukkiriza kwange mu Kristo.”

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Mu kaweefube w’okubuulira enjiri ku kizinga Mei-hua okumpi n’olubalama lwa China ey’Obukiikaddyo, Watchman Nee n’ekibinja ekitono eky’abakkiriza abavubuka baasanga okuziyizibwa okw’amaanyi okuva mu basinza b’ebifaananyi. Embaga y’ekitundu ey’ekifaananyi Ta-wang yali eneetera okutuuka, era abasinza b’ekifaananyi ekyo ne balangirira n’obwesige nti katonda waabwe yandisindise obudde obulungi ku lunaku lw’okukumba — nga bategeeza nti singa Katonda wa Nee yali wa ddala, yandiraze amaanyi ge.

Nee n’ekibinja kye baasaba. Ku makya g’olunaku lw’embaga, bwe baali basaba okwebaza Katonda ku kyenkya, enkuba n’etandika okutonnya — mpola mu kusooka, oluvannyuma n’efuuka ey’amaanyi ennyo. Abaasitula ekifaananyi baalemererwa okukisitula mu kukumba ne beesittala, ne bakigwisa ne kimenyeka akalevu n’omukono. Amaanyi g’ekifaananyi ku kizinga gaamenyebwa. Abavubuka abawerako ne bakyukira Kristo amangu ago.

Abakadde b’ekyalo ne balangirira nti olunaku olukyamu lwe lwali lulondeddwa, ne balangirira olunaku olupya olw’okukumba: olw’ekkumi n’ena. Nee n’ekibinja kye ne baddamu okusaba, nga basaba obudde obulungi wakati w’ennaku ezo ebbiri basobole okubuulira, n’enkuba nate ku lw’ekkumi n’ena. Katonda yaddamu ddala bwe batyo: ennaku ez’obudde obulungi ez’okubuulira zaavaamu abakyufu amakumi asatu, n’oluvannyuma, ddala ku lw’ekkumi n’ena, enkuba ey’amaanyi n’etonnya mu ssaawa eyalagirwa. Nee yawandiika: “Twajjukiza Mukama ensonga eyo mu kasirise. Awatali kulwawo wadde eddakiika emu, okuddamu kwe kwajja n’enkuba ey’amaanyi n’amataba nga bwe kyali olubereberye. Amaanyi g’ekifaananyi ku bantu b’ekizinga gaamenyebwa; omulabe yawangulwa. Okusaba okw’okukkiriza kwali kuleese obuwanguzi obunene.”

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Abaruumi 8:26 – 27 (OLCB) — “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka.”

1 Yokaana 5:14 – 15 (OLCB) — “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.”

Abaefeso 6:18 (OLCB) — “nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Essaala zaffe ze ziteeka oluguudo lw’eggaali amaanyi ga Katonda mwe gayinza okuyita. Ng’eggaali y’omukka ey’amaanyi, amaanyi ge tegayinza kuziyizibwa, naye tegayinza kututuukako awatali nnyiriri za ggaali.”

“Ekigendererwa ky’okusaba si kutegeeza Katonda wabula okulaga obwesige bwaffe, okukkiriza kwaffe, okusuubira kwaffe, n’okwegomba kw’emitima gyaffe.”

“Obulagajjavu mu kusaba buwotoza omuntu ow’omunda. Tewali kiyinza kudda mu kifo kyakwo, wadde omulimu gw’Ekikristaayo. Okusaba kutusobozesa okusooka okuwangula omulabe munda, n’oluvannyuma okulwanagana naye ebweru.”

“Okusaba kwe kugezesa okw’amazima okw’amaanyi g’omuntu ow’omunda. Omwoyo ogw’amaanyi gusobola okusaba ennyo n’okusaba n’obugumiikiriza bwonna okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja.”

“Ka tutegeere ekintu kino kimu: omugugu kye kyama ky’okusaba. Omuntu bw’atawulira munda mu ye mugugu gwa kusabira nsonga emu, kizibu nnyo okubeera n’obuwanguzi mu kusaba. ” Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda “Tetusaanidde kwanguyiriza kwasamya kamwa kaffe nga tusemberera Katonda. Wabula, tulina okusooka okusaba Katonda atulage kye tusaba n’engeri y’okusaba nga tetunnamutegeeza kye twetaaga. Mu biseera eby’emabega tetwamala biseera bingi nnyo nga tusaba bye twagala?

Lwaki kaakano tetusaba Katonda by’ayagala?”

“Okusaba okukwatagana n’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala kusoboka kyokka nga ffe ffennyini tuli mu kukwatagana n’ebyo by’ayagala.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Okusaba mulimu. Ebyo abaana ba Katonda bangi bye bayiseemu biraga nti kutuukiriza bingi nnyo okusinga engeri endala yonna ey’omulimu. Era lutalo, kubanga kye kimu ku byokulwanyisa mu kulwanyisa omulabe. Kyokka, okusaba mu Mwoyo kwokka kwe kukola ddala.”

“Omugugu Katonda gw’atuwa guggyibwawo bwe tumala okusaba, naye obuzito obuva eri omulabe tebuyinza kuggyibwawo okuggyako nga tulwanye era ne tuziyiza mu kusaba.”

“Lwaki Abakristaayo bangi bwe batyo basaba essaala entono bwe zityo ate nga Katonda waabwe mukulu nnyo?”

fields.title: D. L. Moody (1837 – 1899)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Dwight Lyman Moody yazaalibwa nga 5 Febwali 1837 e Northfield, Massachusetts, nga ye mwana ow’omukaaga ku baana mwenda. Kitaawe yafa ng’alina emyaka ena, n’aleka amaka mu bwavu. Yasoma okutuuka mu kibiina eky’okutaano kyokka, era bwe yaweza emyaka kkumi na musanvu n’asengukira e Boston okukola mu dduuka ly’engatto erya kojja we. Yakyuka mu 1855 ng’alina emyaka kkumi na munaana, omusomesa we ow’essomero lya Ssande Edward Kimball bwe yajja mu dduuka ly’engatto n’amuleeta eri Kristo emabega w’emmeeza y’edduuka.

Bwe yasengukira e Chicago, Moody yeewaayo ddala mu mulimu gw’Ekikristaayo — YMCA, essomero lya Ssande ery’abaana abaavu ab’omu byalo by’abaavu mu kibuga, n’ekkanisa eyetongodde eyakula n’efuuka ekibiina ky’abantu 1,500. Yali muntu wa maanyi mangi, ow’ekisa, era ow’okwagala okw’ebikolwa. Omuliro Omunene ogwa Chicago ogwa 1871 bwe gwazikiriza ekizimbe ky’ekkanisa ye, yasigala nga talina kantu — naye ekyaddirira kwali kusoomoozebwa kw’okusaba okwamukyusa.

Mu 1871, bwe yali e New York ng’anoonya ensimbi ez’okuddamu okuzimba, Moody yali atambula mu luguudo amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne gamukkako mu ngeri ey’amaanyi ennyo n’atuuka okusaba Katonda akome. Okubuulira kwe amangu ago kwakyuka mu maanyi ne mu bivaamu, era abantu ebikumi baakyukanga buli gye yagendanga. Okuva olwo n’afuuka omubuulizi w’enjiri eri ebibiina ebinene asinga obukulu mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda.

Wamu n’omuyimbi Ira Sankey, Moody yakulembera enkuŋŋaana ennene ez’enjiri mu Amerika ne Bungereza ezaafuuka ebiseera ebikulu mu byafaayo by’Abakristaayo ab’enjiri. Yatandikawo Moody Bible Institute e Chicago mu 1889, Northfield Schools mu Massachusetts, n’ekitongole ekikuba ebitabo ekikyalina erinnya lye. Kiteeberezebwa nti yabuulira abantu abasoba mu bukadde 100 mu bulamu bwe. Yafa nga 22 Ddesemba 1899 n’aziikibwa mu kibuga ky’ewaabwe Northfield.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Omuliro Omunene ogwa Chicago ogwa 1871 bwe gwamala okwokya ekkanisa ye n’emisingi egisinga obungi egy’obuweereza bwe, Moody yamenyeka. Abakyala babiri mu kibiina kye baali bamaze emyezi nga bamubuulira ku bwetaavu bw’okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Yali abasuulirira. Kaakano, ng’aggyiddwako buli kimu, yatandika okusaba n’obwetaavu obw’amaanyi.

Bwe yali atambula mu nguudo za New York ng’asonda ensimbi ez’ekizimbe ekipya, Katonda n’amusisinkana. Moody yennyini yakinnyonnyola bw’ati: “Nnali nkaaba buli kiseera Katonda anjijuze Omwoyo we. Awo, lumu mu kibuga New York — ayi, nga lwali lunaku! — sisobola kulunnyonnyola, ntera obutayogera ku lwo; kumpi kye kintu ekitukuvu ennyo okukyogerako. Nsobola kugamba bugambi nti Katonda yeeyoleka gye ndi, era ne nfuna okwagala kwe mu ngeri bw’eti nnasaba azzeeyo omukono gwe. Ne nziramu okubuulira. Okubuulira kwange tekwali kwa njawulo; saaleeta mazima gonna mapya; naye abantu ebikumi baakyuka. Sandikkirizza kuzzibwa we nnali nga sinnafuna kintu ekyo eky’omukisa olw’ensi yonna.”

Omuliro gwa Katonda gwali gukka ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba. Okuva mu kaseera ako Moody yagenda mu maaso n’okubuulira Enjiri eri obukadde n’obukadde, n’ajjuza ebisaawe ebisinga obunene mu Amerika ne Bungereza, n’akyusa obulamu bw’Obukristaayo obw’enjiri mu nsi yonna.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Abaruumi 10:17 (OLCB) — “Noolwekyo okukkiriza kujja olw’okuwulira ekigambo kya Kristo.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8 (OLCB) — “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”

Matayo 9:37 – 38 (OLCB) — “Eby’okukungula bingi nnyo, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okusaba tekitegeeza nti nnina okuleeta Katonda wansi mu birowoozo byange n’ebigendererwa byange, n’okuweta obufuzi bwe okugoberera endowooza zange ez’obusirusiru, ez’ekisiru, era oluusi ez’ekibi.

Okusaba kitegeeza nti nnina okusitulibwa waggulu mu kuwulira, mu kwegatta n’ekigendererwa wamu naye; nti nnina okuyingira mu kuteesa kwe n’okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kye mu bujjuvu.”

“Mu ssaala zaffe, twogera ne Katonda; mu kusoma Bayibuli, Katonda ayogera naffe; era kirungi tuleke Katonda y’asinga okwogera.”

“Nandisinze okwagala okumanya okusaba okusinga okubeera omubuulizi omukulu; Yesu Kristo teyayigiriza bayigirizwa be ngeri ya kubuulira, wabula engeri ya kusaba yokka.”

“Oluvannyuma lw’ekyewuunyo eky’okulaba Omulokozi wange, ndowooza ekyewuunyo ekiddako kijja kuba nti nnakozesa kitono nnyo amaanyi g’okusaba.”

“Omukristaayo afukamidde alaba bingi okusinga omufirosoofo ayimiridde ku nsonga z’ebigere. Katonda tewali gw’asindika ng’agenda engalo nsa okuggyako abo abajjudde bo bennyini.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Nnasaba okukkiriza, ne ndowooza nti lumu okukkiriza kujja kukka kunkube ng’okumyansa kw’eggulu. Naye okukkiriza kwalabika ng’okutajja. Lumu ne nsoma mu ssuula ey’ekkumi ey’Abaruumi, “Noolwekyo okukkiriza kujja olw’okuwulira ekigambo kya Kristo.” Nnali nzigadde Bayibuli yange ne nsaba okukkiriza. Kaakano ne nzibikkula Bayibuli yange ne ntandika okugisoma n’obwegendereza, era okukkiriza kubadde kukula okuva olwo.”

“Ekintu kimu kye nkizudde nga nsoma Ekigambo kya Katonda: omuntu bw’ajjula Omwoyo, ayogera nnyo ku Kigambo kya Katonda; so ng’omuntu ajjudde ebirowoozo bye ye tatera kwogera ku Kigambo kya Katonda.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Bayibuli awatali Mwoyo Omutukuvu eba ng’essaawa y’omusana ku kitangaala ky’omwezi.”

“Nzikiriza ddala nti mu kaseera emitima gyaffe lwe giggyibwamu okwefaako, n’okwegomba ekitiibwa, n’okwenoonyeza, ne buli kintu ekikontana n’amateeka ga Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu ajja kujja ajjuze buli nsonda y’emitima gyaffe. Naye bwe tuba nga tujjudde amalala n’okwekulumbaza n’okwegomba n’ensi, tewabaawo bbanga lya Mwoyo wa Katonda. Nga tetunnasaba Katonda atujjuze, nzikiriza nti tusaanidde okusaba atusooke atuggyemu byonna.”

“Omwoyo wa Katonda asooka kuwa kwagala; oluvannyuma aleeta essuubi, n’alyoka awa eddembe; era ekyo kumpi kye kintu ekisembayo ekisangibwa mu makanisa gaffe mangi.”

fields.title: R. A. Torrey (1856 – 1928)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Reuben Archer Torrey yazaalibwa nga 28 Janwali 1856 e Hoboken, New Jersey. Yali muyivu nnyo, n’atikkirwa mu Yale University n’oluvannyuma mu Yale Divinity School, n’alyoka yeeyongera okusoma eby’eddiini mu yunivasite za Leipzig ne Erlangen mu Bugirimaani. Yatuuka ku kukkiriza okw’amazima mu Kristo oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’okumeggana n’okubuusabuusa, n’oluvannyuma n’abatizibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu mu kintu ekyakyusa obuweereza bwe.

Mu 1889, D. L. Moody yayita Torrey okufuuka omukulu eyasooka ow’ekyafuuka Moody Bible Institute e Chicago. Torrey yaweereza wamu ne Moody n’obwesigwa, era Moody bwe yafa mu 1899, Torrey n’atwala ekifo ky’omukulembeze w’Abakristaayo ab’enjiri asinga obukulu mu nsi. Era n’afuuka omusumba wa Moody Church.

Okuva mu 1902 okutuuka mu 1907, Torrey yakulembera kampeyini ez’ekitalo ez’okubuulira enjiri mu nsi yonna, n’alaba abantu emitwalo n’emitwalo nga bajja eri Kristo mu Australia, New Zealand, Buyindi, China, Bungereza, ne Amerika. Okuzuukuka kwa Australia okwa 1902 – 1903 kwokka kwalabamu abakyufu abateeberezebwa okuba emitwalo kkumi mu bibuga ebinene.

Oluvannyuma Torrey yafuuka Dean w’eyo kaakano eyitibwa Biola University e Los Angeles era omusumba wa Church of the Open Door. Yawandiika ebitabo ebisoba mu amakumi ana, nga Engeri y’Okusaba ne Amaanyi g’Okusaba bye bikyasinga okwagalibwa. Yafa nga 26 Okitobba 1928, ng’amaze obulamu bwe bwonna ng’atendeka ekkanisa mu by’eddiini n’enkola y’okusaba okuweebwa amaanyi Omwoyo.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Okuzuukuka kwa Australia okwa 1902 kwe kuddibwamu kw’essaala okusinga obukulu mu bulamu bwa Torrey. Kampeyini nga tennatandika, Torrey n’ekibinja kye baamala emyezi nga basaba obutakoma, nga bakaabirira Katonda olw’omulimu gw’Omwoyo ogw’amazima. Baagaana okusenvuka okutuusa lwe baafuna obukakafu nti Katonda awulidde.

Enkuŋŋaana bwe zaatandika e Melbourne, ebyavaamu byewuunyisa nnyo. Amakanisa gaali gajjudde nga gayiika. Abasajja abakakanyavu baakaaba amaziga. Amaka gonna gaakyukira mu lukuŋŋaana lumu. Empapula z’amawulire ez’omu kitundu — ezitaamanyiddwa kuwagira kkanisa — zaawandiika ku bintu ebyo eby’ekitalo. E Sydney, Brisbane, Auckland, ne mu bibuga ebirala, omukisa gwe gumu gwayitamu ng’amayengo. Torrey yateebereza abakyufu ab’amazima abasoba mu mitwalo kkumi mu kampeyini eyo. Buli omu ku bo yamutwala nti yava mu kusaba: okusaba nga kampeyini tennatandika, okusaba mu nkuŋŋaana, n’okusaba kw’abeegayirizi abeesigwa abaali emabega.

Torrey bulijjo yayigirizanga nti enjawulo esalawo mu buweereza bwonna si kitone ky’omubuulizi wabula okusaba kw’ekkanisa: “Setaani bw’alaba omusajja oba omukazi akkiriza ddala mu kusaba, amanyi okusaba, era asaba ddala, era okusinga byonna, bw’alaba ekkanisa yonna nga yeevuunise mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba, akankana nga bwe yakankananga bulijjo, kubanga amanyi nti olunaku lwe mu kkanisa eyo oba mu kitundu ekyo luweddeyo.”

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Yakobo 5:16 (OLCB) — “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo.”

Abaruumi 8:26 (OLCB) — “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka.”

1 Yokaana 5:14 (OLCB) — “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Bwe tuba twagala okusaba obulungi, ekintu ekisooka kye tusaanidde okukola kwe kukakasa nti ddala tufuna okusisinkana ne Katonda, nti ddala tuyingira mu maaso ge ddala. Nga tetunnaleeta kigambo kya kusaba, tusaanidde okubeera n’okumanya okutegeerekeka nti twogera ne Katonda, era tukkirize nti atuwuliriza era nti agenda kutuwa ekyo kye tumusaba.”

“Tutaawaana nnyo ne tutafuna budde kusaba, era bwe tutyo tutaawaana nnyo ne tutafuna maanyi. Tulina emirimu mingi nnyo, naye tutuukiriza bitono; enkuŋŋaana nnyingi, naye abakyufu batono; ebyuma bingi, naye ebivaamu bitono.”

“Byonna Katonda by’ali, ne byonna Katonda by’alina, biri mu buyinza bw’okusaba. Okusaba kuyinza okukola buli kintu Katonda ky’ayinza okukola, era nga Katonda bw’ayinza okukola buli kimu, okusaba kwa buyinza bwonna.”

“Ayi, abasajja n’abakazi, musabe okutuusa ku nkomerero; musabe okutuusa ku nkomerero! Temutandika butandisi kusaba ne musaba akaseera katono ne mugolola emikono ne muvaako; naye musabe era musabe era musabe okutuusa Katonda lw’anaakutamya eggulu n’akka.”

“Okusaba okw’obuwanguzi kumpi tekusoboka awali obulagajjavu mu kusoma Ekigambo kya Katonda.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Okusaba okuzaalibwa mu kufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda kwe kusaba okulinnya waggulu mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo, okutuuka ku matu ga Katonda ag’okuwuliriza.”

“Bwe mba nga nnina okubeera n’okukkiriza nga nsaba, nnina okuzuula ekisuubizo mu Kigambo kya Katonda kwe nnyimiriza okukkiriza kwange. Bayibuli ejjudde ebisuubizo bya Katonda okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Bikwate obisabe ng’obizzaayo eri Katonda.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Okuyingira mu maaso ga Katonda kusoboka kyokka olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kale tusaanidde okutunuulira Omwoyo Omutukuvu atukulembere ddala mu maaso ga Katonda, era tetusaanidde kwanguyiriza bigambo okutuusa ng’amaze ddala okututuusa eyo.”

“Omwoyo, bw’asaba ng’ayita mu ffe, oba bw’atuyamba okutuukiriza “ekiteekwa” eky’amaanyi eky’okusaba okutuufu, asala okusaba kwaffe ne kukwatagana n’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala.”

“Tulina okumanya amaanyi g’Omusaayi bwe tuba nga twagala okumanya amaanyi ga Katonda. Okumanya kwaffe mu bumanyirivu amaanyi g’Ekigambo, amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’amaanyi g’okusaba kwesigamye ku kumanya kwaffe amaanyi g’Omusaayi gwa Kristo.”

Okuva mu 1902 okutuuka mu 1907, Torrey yakulembera kampeyini ez’ekitalo ez’okubuulira enjiri mu nsi yonna, n’alaba abantu emitwalo n’emitwalo nga bajja eri Kristo mu Australia, New Zealand, Buyindi, China, Bungereza, ne Amerika. Okuzuukuka kwa Australia okwa 1902 – 1903 kwokka kwalabamu abakyufu abateeberezebwa okuba emitwalo kkumi mu bibuga ebinene. Oluvannyuma Torrey yafuuka Dean w’eyo kaakano eyitibwa Biola University e Los Angeles era omusumba wa Church of the Open Door. Yawandiika ebitabo ebisoba mu amakumi ana, nga Engeri y’Okusaba ne Amaanyi g’Okusaba bye bikyasinga okwagalibwa. Yafa nga 26 Okitobba 1928, ng’amaze obulamu bwe bwonna ng’atendeka ekkanisa mu by’eddiini n’enkola y’okusaba okuweebwa amaanyi Omwoyo. Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu Okuzuukuka kwa Australia okwa 1902 kwe kuddibwamu kw’essaala okusinga obukulu mu bulamu bwa Torrey. Kampeyini nga tennatandika, Torrey n’ekibinja kye baamala emyezi nga basaba obutakoma, nga bakaabirira Katonda olw’omulimu gw’Omwoyo ogw’amazima. Baagaana okusenvuka okutuusa lwe baafuna obukakafu nti Katonda awulidde. Enkuŋŋaana bwe zaatandika e Melbourne, ebyavaamu byewuunyisa nnyo. Amakanisa gaali gajjudde nga gayiika. Abasajja abakakanyavu baakaaba amaziga. Amaka gonna gaakyukira mu lukuŋŋaana lumu. Empapula z’amawulire ez’omu kitundu — ezitaamanyiddwa kuwagira kkanisa — zaawandiika ku bintu ebyo eby’ekitalo. E Sydney, Brisbane, Auckland, ne mu bibuga ebirala, omukisa gwe gumu gwayitamu ng’amayengo. Torrey yateebereza abakyufu ab’amazima abasoba mu mitwalo kkumi mu kampeyini eyo. Buli omu ku bo yamutwala nti yava mu kusaba: okusaba nga kampeyini tennatandika, okusaba mu nkuŋŋaana, n’okusaba kw’abeegayirizi abeesigwa abaali emabega. Torrey bulijjo yayigirizanga nti enjawulo esalawo mu buweereza bwonna si kitone ky’omubuulizi wabula okusaba kw’ekkanisa: “Setaani bw’alaba omusajja oba omukazi akkiriza ddala mu kusaba, amanyi okusaba, era asaba ddala, era okusinga byonna, bw’alaba ekkanisa yonna nga yeevuunise mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba, akankana nga bwe yakankananga bulijjo, kubanga amanyi nti olunaku lwe mu kkanisa eyo oba mu kitundu ekyo luweddeyo.” Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu Yakobo 5:16 (OLCB) — “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo.” Abaruumi 8:26 (OLCB) — “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Okumanya kwaffe mu bumanyirivu amaanyi g’Ekigambo, amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’amaanyi g’okusaba kwesigamye ku kumanya kwaffe amaanyi g’Omusaayi gwa Kristo.”

fields.title: E. M. Bounds (1835 – 1913)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Edward McKendree Bounds yazaalibwa nga 15 Agusito 1835 mu Shelby County, mu Missouri. Yatendekebwa okuba looya era n’akkirizibwa okukola omulimu ogwo ng’aweza emyaka kkumi n’omwenda, naye mu myaka mitono yawulira okuyitibwa kwa Katonda n’amaanyi mangi ne kiba nti yaleka omulimu gw’amateeka n’ayingira obuweereza mu kkanisa y’Abametodisiti. Okuva ku ntandikwa yali musajja wa bunyiikivu n’okwewaayo okw’ekitalo.

Mu Lutalo lw’Omunda olw’Amerika, Bounds yaweereza ng’omusumba w’amagye g’Abakonfederete. Yalumizibwa mu lutalo lw’e Franklin, mu Tennessee, era n’amala ekiseera ng’omusibe w’olutalo. Olutalo bwe lwaggwa, yaddayo mu buweereza bw’obusumba, ng’aweereza ekkanisa mu Missouri, mu Alabama ne mu Tennessee. Okumala emyaka munaana yali musunsuzi w’olupapula lw’amawulire Christian Advocate e Nashville.

Bounds teyali mwatiikirivu mu bulamu bwe. Yaweereza nga tamanyiddwa nnyo. Naye okuva mu makkati g’emyaka gya 1880 okutuusa lwe yafa mu 1913, buli ku makya yagolokokanga ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro n’asaba okumala essaawa ssatu ng’abalala mu maka tebannazuukuka. Ekyo yakikolanga buli lunaku okumala emyaka amakumi asatu. Teyakoma ku kuwandiika ku kusaba kwokka — yakubeerangamu.

Mu ssaawa ezo ez’oku makya ennyo, Bounds era yawandiikanga. Yawandiika ebiwandiiko munaana ebikwata ku kusaba, ng’annyonnyola obwetaavu bwakwo, amaanyi gaakwo, ebyokulwanyisa byakwo, n’akakwate kaakwo n’omubuulizi wamu n’ekkanisa. Kimu kyokka ku byo kye kyafulumizibwa ng’akyali mulamu — Omubuulizi n’Okusaba, ekyafuluma mu 1907, era ekimanyiddwa leero nga Amaanyi Okuyita mu Kusaba. Bwe yamala okufa nga 24 Agusito 1913, mikwano gye baakuŋŋaanya ebiwandiiko ebyali bisigaddewo ne babifulumya. Okuva olwo bitunze kopi bukadde na bukadde, era bikyali mu biwandiiko ebisinga amaanyi n’okunenya omutima ku kusaba ebiriwo.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Essaala esinga obunene eyaddibwamu mu bulamu bwa E. M. Bounds kwe kufulumizibwa kw’ebitabo bye omunaana ku kusaba n’engeri gye byakwatamu ensi yonna — musanvu ku byo teyabiraba nga bifulumiziddwa, era byawandiikibwa mu ssaawa ez’ekyama ez’okusaba ku makya ennyo.

Bounds yasaba n’obwesigwa okumala emyaka amakumi asatu nga tamanyiddwa, ng’akkiriza nti Ekkanisa yali yeetaaga nnyo okuzuukusibwa etegeere amaanyi n’obwetaavu bw’okusaba. Kumpi teyalaba ku bibala bya kufuba kwe mu bulamu bwe. Naye Katonda yali awuliriza. Mu kyasa ekyaddirira okufa kwe, ebitabo bye bisiikudde abasumba n’abeegayirizi bukadde na bukadde okwewaayo eri okusaba, era enkosa yaabyo yeeyongera bweyongezi.

Kino kyennyini bujulirwa bumu ku businga amaanyi ku ngeri Katonda gy’addamu essaala: nti oluusi Katonda addamu essaala zaffe si mu bulamu bwaffe, wabula okuyita mu busika bwe tulekawo. Essaala ya Bounds — nti Ekkanisa ezzibwemu amaanyi okuyita mu kutegeera okusaba mu buziba — eddiddwamu ku kigero kye yali tayinza na kulowooza.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Lukka 18:1 (OLCB) — “Bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo.”

Abaefeso 6:18 (OLCB) — “nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera. Mwekuumenga nga mugumiikirizanga, era nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu, be bantu bonna aba Katonda.”

Yokaana 15:16 (OLCB) — “Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera. Olwo buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Ekkanisa ky’etaaga leero si byuma bingi oba ebisingako, si bibiina bipya oba enkola empya ennyingi, wabula abantu Omwoyo Omutukuvu b’ayinza okukozesa — abantu b’okusaba, abantu ab’amaanyi mu kusaba. Omwoyo Omutukuvu tayita mu nkola, wabula ayita mu bantu. Tajja ku byuma, wabula ku bantu. Tafuka mafuta ku nteekateeka, wabula ku bantu — abantu b’okusaba.”

“Essaala ziwangaala okusinga obulamu bw’abo abaziwaayo; ziwangaala okusinga omulembe, okusinga ekyasa, okusinga ensi.”

“Okutwetooloola waliwo ensi ebuze mu kibi, waggulu waffe waliwo Katonda ayagala era asobola okulokola; ffe tulina okuzimba olutindo olugatta eggulu n’ensi, era okusaba kye kikozesebwa eky’amaanyi ekikola omulimu ogwo.”

“Okwogera n’abantu ku lwa Katonda kintu kikulu, naye okwogera ne Katonda ku lw’abantu kye kisinga obukulu.”

“Okusaba kye kintu ekisinga obwangu era ekisinga obuzibu mu byonna; ekisinga obwangu era ekisinga okugulumira; ekisinga obunafu era ekisinga amaanyi; ebivaamu biri wala ennyo okusukka obusobozi bw’omuntu — bikomezebwa buyinza bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo bwokka.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Ekigambo kya Katonda kye kiwanirizo omuggo gw’okusaba kwe guteekebwa, era kwe gusitulira ebintu n’amaanyi. Katonda ayogera n’omuntu mu Bayibuli; omuntu ayogera ne Katonda mu kusaba.

Omuntu asoma Bayibuli okuzuula Katonda ky’ayagala; asaba alyoke afune amaanyi okukola ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala.”

“Ekigambo kya Katonda y’emmere eriisa okusaba n’ekukuza amaanyi. Tewali bintu bibiri bisinga kwetaagisa mu bulamu obujjudde Omwoyo okusinga okusoma Bayibuli n’okusaba mu kyama.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Omutima gwonna bwe gukwatibwa okwegomba okw’amaanyi okw’okusaba, olwo omuliro oguleeta obulamu ne gukka, kubanga tewali n’omu atuuka ku kutu kwa Katonda okuggyako omuntu anyiikira.”

“Abantu Omwoyo Omutukuvu b’ayinza okukozesa — abantu b’okusaba, abantu ab’amaanyi mu kusaba. Omwoyo Omutukuvu tajja ku byuma wabula ku bantu. Tafuka mafuta ku nteekateeka, wabula ku bantu — abantu b’okusaba.”

“Buli kutambula okw’amaanyi okw’Omwoyo wa Katonda kwasibuka mu kisenge eky’okusabiramu.”

fields.title: Jonathan Edwards (1703 – 1758)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Jonathan Edwards yazaalibwa nga 5 Okitobba 1703 mu East Windsor, mu Connecticut, mu maka agajjudde okutya Katonda okw’Abapulitaani. Kitaawe yali musumba, ate nnyina yali muwala w’omubuulizi omwatiikirivu Solomon Stoddard. Edwards yayingira Yale College ng’alina emyaka kkumi n’esatu era n’atikkirwa ng’alina kkumi na musanvu. Oluvannyuma lw’okweyongerayo okusoma, mu 1727 yafuuka omuyambi wa jjajjaawe e Northampton, mu Massachusetts, era Stoddard bwe yafa mu 1729 n’asigala yekka ng’alabirira ekibiina.

Edwards teyali mubuulizi bubuulizi — yali omu ku basinga amagezi mu byafaayo by’Amerika.

Yasoma abafirosoofo Locke ne Newton n’ageraageranya ebirowoozo byabwe n’Ebyawandiikibwa, n’azimba enjigiriza ey’obuziba n’obulungi obw’ekitalo. Omulamwa gwe yasinga okwagala gwe gwali obukulu n’obufuzi bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo, n’engeri abantu gye beesigama ddala ku kisa kya Katonda kyokka.

Mu 1734 – 35, okuzuukuka okw’amaanyi kwabalukawo e Northampton mu buweereza bwe. Abantu abasukka mu 300 ku batuuze 1,100 baatula okukkiriza kwabwe mu myezi mukaaga. Lipoota ye, Ennyonnyola Entuufu ey’Omulimu gwa Katonda Ogwewuunyisa, yakankanya Amerika ne Bungereza, n’eyamba okutegeka ettaka ly’Okuzuukuka Okunene okwa 1740 – 42 — oboolyawo kwe kuzuukuka okw’omwoyo okusinga obukulu mu byafaayo by’Amerika.

Mu 1750, ekibiina kye yennyini kyamugoba mu ngeri eyaleeta enkaayana, n’amala emyaka musanvu ng’omuminsani mu Bannansi b’Amerika e Stockbridge, mu Massachusetts. Oluvannyuma yayitibwa okufuuka Pulezidenti wa Princeton College, naye n’afa olw’okugemebwa kawaali nga 22 Maaki 1758, wiiki ntono nga yakatandika omulimu ogwo. Akyali munnaddiini asinga obukulu Amerika gw’ezaddeko, era ebiwandiiko bye ku kuzuukuka, ku kusaba ne ku mulimu gw’Omwoyo tebiriiko bye bigeraageranyizibwa nabyo.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Okuzuukuka kwa 1734 – 35 e Northampton kwali kuddibwamu butereevu kw’essaala ez’emyaka mingi ez’ekibiina ekitono ekyagaana okuggwamu essuubi mu Katonda. Edwards yennyini yannyonnyola embeera y’omwoyo ey’ekibuga ng’okuzuukuka tekunnatandika ng’ennafu ennyo — abavubuka nga bamaliddwa okutambulatambula ekiro, okunywera mu bbaala n’obwenzi; abakulembeze b’ekitundu nga bali mu nkaayana enkambwe; n’ekkanisa ntono era etakola nnyo.

Okufa kw’abantu babiri amangu mu biseera by’omusana mu 1734 kwakankanya ekibuga ne kitandika okufumiitiriza. Mu kiseera kye kimu, Edwards yatandika okubuulira n’amaanyi agamalirivu ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza kwokka. fields.title: Charles Finney (1792 – 1875)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Charles Grandison Finney yazaalibwa nga 29 Agusito 1792 mu Warren, mu Connecticut. Yakulira ku nsalo y’Amerika mu bukiikakkono bwa New York, teyasoma nnyo mu masomero, era n’atendekebwa okuba looya. Bwe yali asoma amateeka, yakizuula nti ebitabo by’amateeka byajulizanga Bayibuli emirundi mingi. Yagula Bayibuli okukebera ebyo ebyajulizibwanga — era Bayibuli n’emuwamba.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi mingi ng’alwana n’emmeeme ye, Finney yeewaayo eri Kristo nga 10 Okitobba 1821, mu kukyuka okw’amaanyi okwamukyusa ddala, mu kibira okumpi n’awaka we. Akawungeezi ako kennyini yabatizibwa n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu ngeri gye yannyonnyola nga “amayengo agaddiringana ag’okwagala okukulukuta”. Amangu ago yaleka omulimu gwe ogw’amateeka n’atandika okubuulira.

Finney yakola omulimu gw’okuleeta okuzuukuka okuva mu 1825 okutuuka mu 1835, era ebyavaamu byali bya kitalo. Ebibuga byonna byakyuka ddala. Bbaala zaggalwa. Obumenyi bw’amateeka bwakendeera. Buli we yabuuliranga, enkyukakyuka mu bantu zaddiriranga. Kampeyini ye esinga okumanyika yali mu Rochester, mu New York, mu 1830 – 31, abantu abateeberezebwa okuba omutwalo gumu mwe baakyukira, era empisa z’ekibuga kyonna ne zikyuka.

Mu 1835, Finney yayingira mu basomesa b’Oberlin College mu Ohio, ettendekero eryasooka okuyingiza abakazi n’Abamerika abaddugavu. Yaweereza nga pulezidenti waalyo ow’okubiri okuva mu 1851 okutuuka mu 1865. Yawandiika ekitabo eky’ebyafaayo Emisomo ku Kuzuukuka kw’Eddiini, ekisikirizza okuzuukuka kungi okusinga kumpi ekitabo ekirala kyonna ng’oggyeeko Bayibuli, era Katonda kye yakozesa okukoleeza Okuzuukuka kwa Wales mu myaka gya 1840 n’okulala kungi. Yafa mu 1875 ng’alina emyaka 82, era atwalibwa nga Kitaawe w’Okuzuukuka okw’Omulembe Guno.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Okuzuukuka kw’e Rochester okwa 1830 –31 kukyali kye kisinga obunene ku ssaala ezaddibwamu mu buweereza bwa Finney. Kampeyini nga tennatandika, omwegayirizi wa Finney — “Taata Nash” (Daniel Nash) ow’ekitalo — yali amukulembeddemu mu kibuga ennaku ntono emabega, n’apangisa akasenge akatono akaddugavu, n’amala ennaku zonna ng’avuunise amaaso ge mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’akaaba, ng’asiiba, era ng’akaabirira emmeeme.

Finney bwe yatuuka n’atandika okubuulira, Omwoyo wa Katonda yakola n’amaanyi ag’ekitalo. Omusumba omukulu eyakyukira mu nkuŋŋaana ez’e Rochester yawa obujulirwa buno: “Ekitundu kyonna kyakankana. Eddiini lye lyali ensonga eyogerwako mu maka, mu dduuka, mu ofiisi ne ku luguudo. Ekisaawe ky’emizannyo kyokka ekyali mu kibuga kyafuulibwa ekiyumba ky’embalaasi; ekisaawe kya sekiko kyokka ne kifuulibwa ekkolero ly’essabbuuni n’emisubbaawa. Amaduuka g’omwenge gaggalwa; Ssabbiiti n’essibwamu ekitiibwa; amasinzizo ne gajjula abasinza abasanyufu.”

Abantu abasukka mu mutwalo gumu baakyuka ddala mu kampeyini eyo emu. Finney yennyini byonna yabitwala ng’ebyava mu kusaba — okwegayirira kwa Taata Nash okw’ekyama, essaala z’abakkiriza b’omu kitundu, n’okwetegeka okw’amaanyi okw’omutima gwe yennyini nga tannayasamya kamwa ke kubuulira.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Lukka 11:13 (OLCB) — “Kale obanga mmwe ababi muwa abaana bammwe ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisinga nnyo okubawa Mwoyo Mutukuvu abo abamusaba?”

Isaaya 44:3 (OLCB) — “Ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku zadde lyo, era n’omukisa gwange ku bazzukulu bo.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:17 (OLCB) — “Olulituuka mu nnaku ez’oluvannyuma, bw’ayogera Katonda, ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku balina omubiri bonna. Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe baliwa obunnabbi; n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa, n’abakadde baliroota ebirooto.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okuzuukuka kuyinza okusuubirwa Abakristaayo bwe baba n’omwoyo ogw’okusabira okuzuukuka — bwe basaba ng’emitima gyabwe gyonna gikumaliddeko; bwe batambula nga bawuubaala olw’okwegomba kw’emitima gyabwe; bwe baba n’okulumwa okw’amazima mu mmeeme.”

“Tewali kintu kisinga kugatta mitima gy’Abakristaayo okusinga okusabira awamu. Tebaagalana nnyo nga bwe balaba emitima gya bannaabwe nga gifukibwa mu kusaba.”

“Kyali kya bulijjo nnyo okulaba Abakristaayo, buli lwe baasisinkananga wonna, mu kifo ky’okunyumya, nga bafukamira ne basaba.”

“Bayibuli zaffe zigasa ki, bwe tutakwata bisuubizo byazo eby’omuwendo, ne tubikozesa ng’omusingi gw’okukkiriza kwaffe nga tusaba omukisa gwa Katonda?”

“Bw’owulira nga osikirizibwa nnyo okwegomba omukisa, kitegeere ng’akabonero nti Katonda ayagala okukuwa omukisa ogwo gwennyini, era olina okukikkiriza.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Katonda agamba nti mwetegefu okuwa Omwoyo we Omutukuvu abo abamusaba okusinga abazadde bwe baba abeetegefu okuwa abaana baabwe emmere. Wano tulina okukkiriza nti tujja kumufuna bwe tumusaba. Tolina ddembe kuyingizaamu “bwe kiba” n’ogamba nti, “Mukama, bwe kiba nga kye kyagaliza kyo, tuwe Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu.” Ekyo kuvuma Katonda.”

“Okusaba lujegere olukulu mu mukuufu gw’ensonga ezireeta okuzuukuka. Amazima gokka tegayinza kuleeta kivaamu awatali Mwoyo wa Katonda, era Omwoyo oyo aweebwa ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Jjula Omwoyo we, era ajja kukuwa ebintu bingi eby’okusabira. Ajja kukuwa omwoyo ogw’okusaba nga bw’olina amaanyi g’omubiri okugugumira.”

“Naye bwe nnakyuka ne ŋŋenda okutuula okumpi n’omuliro, nnafuna okubatizibwa okw’amaanyi okw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Nga sikisuubira, nga sirowoozangako n’akatono nti waliwo ekintu ng’ekyo ekyange, Omwoyo Omutukuvu yankkako mu ngeri eyalabika ng’empitamu, omubiri n’emmeeme. Nnali mpulira ekikolwa ekyo, ng’ejjengo ly’amasannyalaze, nga kimpitamu emirundi n’emirundi. Mazima kyalabika ng’ekijja mu mayengo agaddiringana ag’okwagala okukulukuta.”

“Okusaba si mulabe wa kukola, tekuziyiza bunyiikivu. Kukola n’amaanyi; okusaba kwennyini gwe mulimu ogusinga obukulu.”

Tolina ddembe kuyingizaamu “bwe kiba” n’ogamba nti, “Mukama, bwe kiba nga kye kyagaliza kyo, tuwe Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu.” Ekyo kuvuma Katonda.” “Okusaba lujegere olukulu mu mukuufu gw’ensonga ezireeta okuzuukuka. fields.title: Rees Howells (1879 – 1950)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Rees Howells yazaalibwa mu 1879 mu kabuga akatono ak’abasimi b’amanda aka Brynamman mu South Wales.

Yakulira mu maka g’abakozi ab’omu Wales, era bwe yali omuvubuka n’agenda okubeera mu Amerika, gye yakwatibwa omusujja gwa typhoid, n’asemberera okufa. Yawona, n’addayo e Wales, era n’asikirizibwa mu Kuzuukuka kwa Wales okwa 1904 – 1905 wansi wa Evan Roberts.

Oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka kwe okw’amaanyi n’okweweerayo ddala eri Katonda okusingawo, Howells yatandika olugendo olw’ekitalo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu mwe yatandikira okumuyigiriza kye yayita “okwegayiririra okw’amazima” — okusaba omuntu mwe yeefaananyiriza n’obwetaavu, mw’alumirwa mu mmeeme, era mw’afunira obuyinza obw’omwoyo. Emisingi gino yasooka kugigezesa mu buweereza obw’omu kitundu, n’oluvannyuma ng’omuminsani mu South Africa, okuzuukuka gye kwagenda kugoberera omulimu gwe.

Mu 1924, Howells yatandikawo Bible College of Wales e Swansea, eyafuuka ekifo eky’okusaba n’okwegayiririra. Ettendekero lyatendeka abaminsani ne libasindika mu mawanga, nga libeera ku kukkiriza kwokka. Mu myaka egyakulembera Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri, Howells yeeyongera okuzitoowererwa ebigenda mu maaso mu nsi, n’okwegayiririra kwe n’akuggya ku nsonga ez’omu kitundu n’akuteeka ku nsonga z’eggwanga n’ez’ensi yonna.

Mu Lutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri (1939 – 1945), Howells n’abantu b’ettendekero lye baasabanga buli kawungeezi okuva ku ssaawa 7 p.m. okutuuka mu ttumbi, n’essaawa endala ku makya. Beegayiririranga butereevu ku biseera ebikulu ebyakyusa olutalo — Dunkirk, Olutalo lwa Bungereza, North Africa, n’ebirala. Bangi bakkiriza nti okwegayiririra kwabwe kwe kwasalawo ebiseera ebyo. Rees Howells yafa mu Febwali 1950, era ebyafaayo bye, Rees Howells: Omwegayirizi ekyawandiikibwa Norman Grubb, okuva olwo bisikirizza emirembe n’emirembe gy’abeegayirizi mu nsi yonna.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Mu ssaala zonna ezaddibwamu mu bulamu bwa Howells, tewali esinga kwewuunyisa okusinga okuggyibwa kw’abaserikale e Dunkirk mu Mayi 1940. Amagye ga Hitler bwe gaali gazza emabega amagye g’Abakago ku lubalama lw’ennyanja mu bukiikakkono bwa Bufalansa, abaserikale Abangereza n’Abafalansa abasukka mu 300,000 baali basibiddwa, nga ttanka za Bugirimaani zibasemberera.

Okulumbibwa kwa Bungereza kwalabika nga tekwewalika.

Ku makya ga nga 21 Mayi 1940, Howells yagamba ettendekero nti: “Jjo lwe lwali olunaku olusinga okuba olw’ekizikiza mu byafaayo by’eggwanga lino … Kaakano tusaanye okusaba Mukama abaziyize okujja mu ggwanga lino.” Ye n’abantu b’ettendekero lye baakaabirira Katonda nga beegayiririra mu bulumi. Nga 28 Mayi, bwe baali basaba Katonda ayingire mu nsonga e Dunkirk awonye abasajja abaali basibiddwa, obukakafu ne bukka ku lukuŋŋaana.

Omu ku baali basaba yakyogera mu bigambo ku nkomerero y’olukuŋŋaana nti: “Nkakasa nti waliwo ekibaddewo.”

Nga 29 Mayi, okuggyibwa kw’abaserikale e Dunkirk, okwatandika mu kiro kya nga 26 Mayi, kwali kugenda mu maaso n’amaanyi gonna. Ennaku bbiri nga tekunnatandika, nga 24 Mayi, ebibinja bya ttanka za Bugirimaani byali biragiddwa okuyimirira nga tebinnatuuka ku lubalama — ekiragiro bannabyafaayo kye bakyakubaganyaako ebirowoozo. Mu kiseera kye kimu, English Channel, ebulijjo eba n’amayengo, yakkakkana mu ngeri ey’ekitalo, ne kisobozesa amaato amatono ag’abantu babulijjo okusomoka ne gakomyawo abaserikale ewaabwe. Abasajja abasukka mu 338,000 baawonyezebwa. Rees Howells yakkiriza nti kwali kuddibwamu kwa kusaba butereevu. Ku Lutalo lwa Bungereza olwaddirira mu kyeya ekyo, Air Chief Marshal Lord Dowding, omukulu wa Fighter Command, oluvannyuma yagamba nti: “Ne mu lutalo lwennyini omuntu yategeeranga buli lunaku obuyambi obungi obwali buva ebweru. Olutalo bwe lwaggwa, omuntu yawulira nga waliwo okuyingira mu nsonga okw’enjawulo okwa Katonda.”

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Isaaya 62:6 – 7 (OLCB) — “Mmwe abakoowoola Mukama temuwummula. Era temumuganya kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi era ng’agifudde ettendo mu nsi.”

Ezeekyeri 22:30 (OLCB) — “Ne nnoonya omuntu mu bo ayinza okuzimba ekisenge era ayinza okubeeyimiririra mu maaso gange ku lw’ensi, naye ne siraba n’omu.”

Abaruumi 8:26 (OLCB) — “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

Howells kumpi teyaleka kintu kyonna kiwandiike ku kusaba. Ebigambo bye bisigaddewo okusinga mu bye baawandiikanga mu nkuŋŋaana z’ettendekero, Norman Grubb bye yajuliza mu byafaayo bye Rees Howells: Omwegayirizi (1952) — era Grubb ye yafunza enjigiriza ye: “Waliwo ebintu bisatu ebirabibwa mu mwegayirizi ebitasangibwa nnyo mu kusaba okwa bulijjo: okwefaananyiriza n’abali mu bwetaavu, okulumwa, n’obuyinza.”

“Katonda tajja kukola kantu na kamu ng’ayita mu ggwe okusukka okukkiriza kw’olina.” — olukuŋŋaana lw’ettendekero, nga 17 Mayi 1940

“Si ggwe alwana, wabula Katonda y’akola, naawe n’otuuka okumanya Katonda ky’akola.” — olukuŋŋaana lw’ettendekero, nga 18 Mayi 1940

“Ensi yonna yafuuka ekitundu kyaffe eky’obuweereza, era ne tukulemberwa okuvunaanyizibwa okwegayiririra ku lw’ensi n’amawanga.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Kaakano kye kiseera ekisinga obulungi okugezesa Baibuli mu ntalo, kubanga naffe tuli mu lumu.” — olukuŋŋaana lw’ettendekero, nga 19 Mayi 1940

“Ekigezo kiri nti, Baibuli ya mazima oba si ya mazima. Ndi mwetegefu okuteeka obulamu bwange mu kabi okukikakasa, era njagala okubabuulira ekiro kino nti ya mazima ddala.” — olukuŋŋaana lw’ettendekero, nga 21 Mayi 1940

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Olutalo lwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Mumulabe ebweru wammwe ekiro kino. Ali eyo ku lutalo n’ekitala kye ekisowoddwa.” — olukuŋŋaana lw’ettendekero, nga 29 Mayi 1940

“Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’amala okugenda ku ludda lw’obuwanguzi, tosobola n’akatono kumatiza musajja oba mukazi eyagenda naye ku ludda lw’obuwanguzi nti alemereddwa.” — olukuŋŋaana lw’ettendekero, nga 19 Mayi 1940

fields.title: Billy Graham (1918 – 2018)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

William Franklin Graham Jr. yazaalibwa nga 7 Novemba 1918 ku faamu y’ente okumpi ne Charlotte, mu North Carolina. Yakulira mu kiseera ky’Ebbula Eddene ery’Ebyenfuna, n’ayiga omugaso gw’okukola ennyo n’okukkiriza okwangu. Mu 1934, ng’alina emyaka kkumi n’etaano, yagenda mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okuzuukuka z’omubuulizi w’enjiri omutambuze Mordecai Ham. Akawungeezi kamu, ng’omutima gumulumiriza, yagenda mu maaso n’awaayo obulamu bwe eri Kristo.

Oluvannyuma lw’okusoma mu Bob Jones College, Florida Bible Institute, ne Wheaton College (gye yasisinkana Ruth Bell eyafuuka mukyala we, muwala w’abaminsani abasawo mu China), Graham yayawulibwa n’atandika obusumba. Mu 1945 yayingira Youth for Christ n’atandika okubuulira mu nkuŋŋaana mu Amerika yonna ne mu Bulaaya ey’oluvannyuma lw’olutalo.

Mu Ssebutemba 1949, Graham yatandika enkuŋŋaana ez’okuzuukuka e Los Angeles. Enkuŋŋaana ez’omu weema ezaali zitegekeddwa okumala wiiki ssatu zongezebwayo okutuuka ku wiiki munaana, ng’ekibuga kikwatiddwa kye empapula z’amawulire zaayita okuzuukuka okw’eddiini okusinga obunene mu byafaayo bya Southern California. Abantu abasukka mu 350,000 baajja, era 3,000 ne bawaayo obulamu bwabwe eri Kristo mu lwatu. Kumpi mu kiro kimu, Billy Graham n’amanyika mu ggwanga lyonna.

Mu myaka amakumi mukaaga egyaddirira, Graham yabuulira Enjiri mu nkuŋŋaana ennene eri abantu abateeberezebwa okuba obukadde 215 mu nsi 185, ng’obukadde obulala bungi butuukibwako okuyita ku leediyo, ku ttivi ne mu firimu. Yawabula bapulezidenti ba Amerika kkumi na babiri. Ye yali omubuulizi w’enjiri omukulu eyasooka okulemerako nti enkuŋŋaana ze zigatte amawanga gonna mu Bukiikaddyo bw’Amerika. Billy Graham Evangelistic Association, gye yatandikawo mu 1950, ekyakola mu nsi yonna. Graham yafiira waka e Montreat, mu North Carolina, nga 21 Febwali 2018, ng’alina emyaka 99.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Enkuŋŋaana ennene ez’e Los Angeles eza 1949 zaazaalibwa okuva mu kusaba okw’ekitalo. Omukago gw’okusabira okuzuukuka ogw’amadiini ag’enjawulo, ogwalimu abakulembeze b’ekkanisa abasukka mu kikumi mu abiri, gwali gumaze emyezi mingi nga gusabira okuzuukuka mu kibuga kyonna nga Graham tannatuuka. Ebibinja by’okusaba ebisukka mu lukumi mu Los Angeles yonna byali byegayiririra kampeyini eno.

Emyezi nga enkuŋŋaana tezinnatandika, Graham yali agenze mu nsozi za San Bernardino ng’ali mu kizibu ky’okukkiriza — ng’alwanagana n’okubuusabuusa ku Bayibuli okw’amagezi. Ng’afukamidde mu maaso ga Katonda, yateeka Bayibuli ye ng’agibikkudde ku kikonge n’agamba, mu bufunze, nti: “Mukama, siyinza kuddamu bibuuzo byonna. Naye nkkiriza Ekitabo kino ng’Ekigambo kyo olw’okukkiriza.” Emirembe emingi ne gimukkako. N’asituka n’agenda okubuulira.

Ebyavaamu byasukka byonna ebyasuubirwa. Omuyimbi w’ennyimba za country amanyiddwa Stuart Hamblen yakyuka, era obulamu bwe obwakyuka ne bufuuka amawulire amakulu. Nnaggagga w’amawulire William Randolph Hearst — olw’ensonga tezinnyonnyolwa bulungi — bwe yaweereza abasunsuzi be bonna obubaka nti “Mumusitule Graham,” kampeyini n’emanyika mu ggwanga lyonna mu kiro kimu. Enkumi baakkiriza mu wiiki ezo omunaana. Graham bulijjo yagambanga nti gwali mulimu gwa kusaba gwokka.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Abaruumi 10:14 (OLCB) — “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu?

Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira?”

2 Timoseewo 4:2 (OLCB) — “Buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu, ng’olaga ebikwekeddwa, ng’onenya, ng’ozaamu amaanyi, wakati mu kugumiikiriza, n’okubonaabona okungi, n’okuyigiriza.”

Yokaana 3:16 (OLCB) — “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

fields.title: Henry Blackaby (1935 – 2024)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Henry Thomas Blackaby yazaalibwa nga 15 Apuli 1935 mu Williams Lake, mu British Columbia, mu Canada. Yafuna diguli esooka mu byafaayo n’Olungereza okuva mu University of British Columbia, ne diguli ze mu by’eddiini okuva mu Golden Gate Baptist Theological Seminary mu California. Yaweereza ng’omukulu w’ennyimba, omukulu w’eby’okusomesa, era ng’omusumba mu California, nga tannaddamu kuyitibwa okw’enjawulo okwakyusa obulamu bwe.

Mu 1970, omusumba Omukanada yajja eri Blackaby n’okusoomoozebwa: “Essuubi lyokka eri Canada liri mu basumba Abakanada okudda ewaabwe.” Blackaby kino yakiwulira ng’ekigambo kya Katonda. Ye ne mukyala we Marilynn baasengukira e Saskatoon, mu Saskatchewan, okulunda Faith Baptist Church — ekibiina ekitono ekyali kifa, eky’abantu kkumi.

Ebyabaawo mu myaka kkumi n’ebiri egyaddirira byali byamagero. Ekkanisa yakula nnyo, n’etandikawo ekkanisa empya n’ebifo by’obuminsani amakumi asatu mu munaana, era n’efuuka ekifo ekikulu eky’Okuzuukuka kw’e Saskatoon okw’ekitalo okwa 1971 — okuzuukuka okwabuna ekibuga kyonna ne kukyusa amadiini gonna. Mu myaka egyo, Blackaby yakola emisingi egyali gigenda okufuuka Okulaba Katonda ng’Akola.

Ekitabo kye Okulaba Katonda ng’Akola: Okumanya n’Okukola Katonda by’Ayagala, kye yawandiika ne mutabani we Richard ne Claude King mu 1990, kitunze kopi ezisukka mu bukadde musanvu era kivvuunuddwa mu nnimi ezisukka mu amakumi ana mu ttaano. Kiyitiddwa ekimu ku bitabo by’Ekikristaayo ebisinga enkosa mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri. Oluvannyuma Blackaby yaweereza mu Home Mission Board eya Southern Baptist Convention ng’Omukulu w’Okusaba n’Okuzuukuka okw’Omwoyo, ng’atambula ensi yonna ng’ayita Ekkanisa okudda eri Katonda. Yafa nga 10 Febwali 2024 ng’alina emyaka 88.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Okuzuukuka kw’e Saskatoon okwa 1971 nga tekunnabalukawo, Henry Blackaby n’ekibinja ky’abasumba b’omu kibuga baali bamaze emyaka ebiri nga bakuŋŋaana buli wiiki, nga basaba Katonda aweereze okuzuukuka mu kibuga kyabwe. Tebaalina kakasa nti waliwo ekigenda okubaawo. Naye baasaba ne balindirira.

Nga 13 Okitobba 1971, abaganda ababuulizi b’enjiri Ralph ne Lou Sutera baatuuka ku nkuŋŋaana ezaali zitegekeddwa okumala wiiki emu n’ekitundu mu Ebenezer Baptist Church. Naye Katonda yalina enteekateeka endala. Mu nnaku ntono, enkuŋŋaana zaali tezikyagya. Ekibiina kyasengukira mu kkanisa ennene, era nayo n’ebooga mu biro bibiri. Baasengukira mu kkanisa esinga obunene mu kibuga — ey’entebe 1,600 — ne bakuba okusinza emirundi ebiri buli kiro. Ku nkomerero, Saskatoon Centennial Auditorium ey’entebe 2,400 yapangisibwa, era ne yo n’ejjula.

Amadiini gonna gaakyuka. Christian and Missionary Alliance yategeeza nti abakyuka beeyongera emirundi ebiri mu mwaka ogwo ogusooka. Abakkiriza ababatize baakizuula nti baali tebazaalibwangako buggya ddala. Amaka gaatabagana. Amabanja gaasasulwa. Abalabe baasonyiyibwa. Blackaby yagamba nti obulamu bwe bwakyuka okuva ku musingi mu kuzuukuka okwo — era emisingi gye yabeeramu mu nnaku ezo gyafuuka obubaka bwe yamala obulamu bwe obwasigalawo ng’abulangirira mu nsi.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Yeremiya 29:13 (OLCB) — “Mulinnoonya ne mundaba bwe mulinnoonya n’omutima gwammwe gwonna.”

Yokaana 14:21 (OLCB) — “Buli anjagala anaagonderanga ebiragiro byange;

Era kubanga anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga.”

Isaaya 55:8 – 9 (OLCB) — “Kubanga ebirowoozo byange si birowoozo byammwe era n’amakubo gammwe si ge makubo gange, bw’ayogera Mukama. Ng’eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi, bwe gatyo amakubo gange bwe gali ewala ennyo n’amakubo gammwe, n’ebirowoozo byange bwe biri eri ebirowoozo byammwe.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okusaba kwakolebwa okukutereeza okutuukana n’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala, so si okutereeza Katonda okutuukana n’ebyo ggwe by’oyagala.”

“Okuzuukuka kwonna kutandikira era kugenda mu maaso mu lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba. Mu biseera by’okuzuukuka, enkumi n’enkumi ziyinza okusangibwa nga zifukamidde okumala essaawa nnyingi, nga zisitula okukaaba kw’emitima, n’okwebaza, eri eggulu.”

“Okusaba nkolagana, so si mukolo gwa ddiini.”

“Katonda bw’addamu essaala yo, afuna ekitiibwa, okukkiriza kwo kweyongera, era ofuna okulaba okuggya okw’okwagala kwe.”

“Abakulembeze abatasaba bali ng’abavuzi b’emmeeri abatalina kkampasi; basobola okuteebereza ekkubo ery’okukwata, naye tebalina bukakafu nti bagenda mu kkubo ttuufu. Okusaba kukuumira abakulembeze ku kintu ekimu mu bulamu ekitakyukakyuka — Katonda.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Katonda ayogera ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu okuyita mu Bayibuli, mu kusaba, mu mbeera, ne mu kkanisa okwebikkula, okubikkula ebigendererwa bye, n’amakubo ge. Bw’oba ng’olemwa okuwulira Katonda ng’ayogera, oli mu buzibu mu mutima gwennyini ogw’obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo.”

“Bw’oyagala okumanya engeri Katonda gy’ayagala otuuke ku kibuga kyo, oba okwenyigira mu mulimu gwe, mubuuze. Ekisuubizo kye kwe kuddangamu bulijjo bwe tusaba okusinziira ku by’ayagala.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Katonda ayogera ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu okuyita mu Bayibuli, mu kusaba, mu mbeera, ne mu kkanisa okwebikkula, okubikkula ebigendererwa bye, n’amakubo ge.”

“Okusaba tekukwata ku kusaba bintu kwokka, wabula ku kukwasaganya okwegomba kwaffe n’enteekateeka za Katonda gy’atulinako. Omwoyo atusindikiriza okunoonya Katonda by’atuterekedde.”

“Okuzuukuka mulimu Katonda gw’atandika, abantu be mwe basabira, ne beenenya ekibi kyabwe, ne bakomawo mu nkolagana entukuvu, ejjudde Omwoyo, ey’obuwulize era ey’okwagala ne Katonda.”

fields.title: Bill Bright (1921 – 2003)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

William R. Bright yazaalibwa nga 19 Okitobba 1921 e Coweta, mu Oklahoma, nga ye mwana ow’omukaaga ku baana musanvu ab’amaka agaalundanga ente. Okutuusa mu kibiina eky’omunaana yasomera mu ssomero ery’ekisenge kimu. Oluvannyuma lw’okuyitira waggulu ennyo mu misomo ku Northeastern State University, yasenguka n’agenda e California n’azimba bizinensi y’ebiwoomerera eyagenda obulungi. Yamanya Enjiri okuyita mu buweereza bwa Henrietta Mears ku Hollywood Presbyterian Church, era mu 1945 yewaayo ddala eri Kristo n’obulamu bwe bwonna.

Bwe yali asomera mu matendekero g’eby’eddiini aga Princeton ne Fuller, Bright yawulira okuyitibwa okw’amaanyi ennyo okuva eri Katonda. fields.title: Loren Cunningham (1935 – 2023)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Loren Duane Cunningham yazaalibwa nga 30 Jjuuni 1935 mu kibuga Taft, mu California, ekyali kigaggawalidde ku mafuta, mu maka agaalimu ababuulizi b’Ekikristaayo okumala emirembe n’emirembe. Okuva mu buto bwe, okusaba n’okukkiriza byalukibwa mu bulamu bwe. Bazadde be baali babuulizi ba Assemblies of God abaali bakulembera mu kwesiga Katonda okw’enkomeredde.

Mu Jjuuni 1956, ng’alina emyaka abiri, Cunningham yali afukamidde ng’asaba mu maka g’omuminsani mu Bahamas, ng’asaba Katonda obubaka bw’anaabuulira akawungeezi ako, n’alaba okwolesebwa okw’ekitalo. Yalaba maapu y’ensi ng’ejjudde obulamu, amayengo nga gakuba ku ssemazinga ne gafuuka abavubuka — enkumi n’enkumi z’abavubuka abasajja n’abakazi okuva mu buli ggwanga, nga bagenda mu buli ggwanga, nga babuulira Enjiri. Teyamanya ngeri ya kukutegeeramu wadde eky’okukukolera, naye n’akuwandiika.

Emyaka ena oluvannyuma, mu 1960, Cunningham n’atandika Youth With A Mission (YWAM) e Lausanne, mu Switzerland, ng’alina emyaka abiri mu ena, wamu ne mukyala we Darlene. YWAM yamenya enkola y’obuminsani ey’emyaka gya 1960 bwe yaaniriza abavubuka abataali baminsani ab’olubeerera okuweereza okumala ekiseera ekitono, nga tebasasulwa, nga tebeesiba ku kkanisa emu, ku ssemazinga yonna. Ekibiina kyakula mu bwangu obw’ekitalo.

Mu 1978, Cunningham yeegatta ku balala okutandika University of the Nations e Kailua-Kona, mu Hawaii. We yafiira nga 6 Okitobba 2023 ng’alina emyaka 88, YWAM yali ekuze okutuuka ku bakozi ab’ekiseera kyonna abasoba mu 20,000 okuva mu mawanga agasoba mu 150, nga baweereza mu bifo ebisoba mu 2,000 mu nsi 191. Cunningham ye muntu eyasooka mu byafaayo okutambula ku lw’Enjiri mu buli ggwanga eryetwala, buli nsi efugibwa endala, n’ebitundu ebisoba mu 100 ku nsi.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

YWAM yakatandika, Cunningham yali yeetaaga faamu ebeere ekifo eky’olubeerera ekisooka eky’obuweereza obwali bukula. Teyalina ssente, teyalina muwagizi, era teyalina ssuubi lyonna lya ddala. N’akola kye yakolanga bulijjo: n’asaba. Awo, mu kukkiriza okuvumu, n’agenda ku katale k’enfuna n’agula omuzingo gwa waya ey’amaggwa, ekidomola ky’amata, n’ekigaali eky’essubi — ebintu bya faamu — nga faamu tennabaawo.

Abayizi be abato ne beewuunya. “Bino bya ki?” ne bamubuuza. “Katonda agenda kutuwa faamu ya YWAM,” bwe yabaddamu obwangu. Mangu ddala, omusajja n’ajja eri Cunningham n’agamba nti, “Njagala kukuwa faamu.” Yali faamu yennyini gye baali beetaaga. Faamu eyo yafuuka ekifo ekikulu eky’ekibiina kyonna mu nsi yonna, era byonna byatandikira mu kusaba n’okukkiriza.

Naye essaala esinga obunene eyaddibwamu mu bulamu bwa Cunningham kwe kutuukirizibwa kw’okwolesebwa okwa 1956 kwennyini. Yamala emyaka nkaaga mu musanvu ng’alaba okwolesebwa okwo nga kutuukirira — amayengo ku mayengo g’abavubuka okuva mu buli ggwanga nga bagenda mu buli ggwanga n’Enjiri ya Kristo. Yalaba obukadde n’obukadde bw’abavubuka nga bakuŋŋaanyizibwa olw’obuminsani okuyita mu YWAM, era n’afa ng’amanyi nti okwolesebwa kwali kukyagenda mu maaso.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Makko 16:15 (OLCB) — “Mugende mu nsi yonna mubuulire Enjiri eri abantu bonna.”

Yokaana 10:27 (OLCB) — “Endiga zange zitegeera eddoboozi lyange, era nzimanyi era zingoberera.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:2 (OLCB) — “Awo bwe baali nga basinza Mukama era nga bwe basiiba, Mwoyo Mutukuvu n’agamba nti, “Munjawulire Balunabba ne Sawulo olw’omulimu gwe mbayitidde.””

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okuwulira Katonda tekuzibu nnyo. Bwe tuba tumanyi Mukama, tuba tumaze okuwulira eddoboozi lye — kubanga okukulemberwa okw’omunda kwe kwatuleeta gy’ali okusooka. Naye tusobola okuwulira eddoboozi lye ne tusubwa ekisinga obulungi ky’atuteekeddeteekedde bwe tutagenda mu maaso n’okuwuliriza.”

“Okulungamizibwa okusooka kwe kubeera n’enkolagana n’Omulungamya.”

“Tusibira mu bibokisi byaffe — naye bwe tusaba nga tufulumye mu byo, ne tusaba Katonda, ebitasoboka BISOBOKA.”

“Twagoberera Emitendera Esatu egy’Okuwulira Katonda: Ogusooka, twakozesa obuyinza bwa Kristo okusirisa omulabe. Ogwokubiri, twasaba Mukama aggye mu birowoozo byaffe buli kye tuteebereza n’endowooza ze tulina edda. Ogwokusatu, twalindirira, nga tukkiriza nti ajja kwogera mu ngeri ne mu kiseera ye by’alonze.”

“Mukama ajja kutukulembera okutuuka ku buwanguzi, naye okutuuka ku buwanguzi kwennyini kye kiziyiza ekisinga obulabe okuwulira obulungi eddoboozi lya Katonda.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Abantu abamala obungi bwe baba ne Bayibuli ne bakozesa by’eyigiriza mu bulamu bwabwe, eggwanga likyuka. Ekitabo kino kye kisumuluzo kya buli kimu.”

“Kino kye kitegeeza okuwulira Katonda — okumumanya obulungi okusingawo. Okusaba okusinga si kakodyo ka kufuna bintu; lwe lulimi lw’enkolagana ne Kitaffe.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Buli kutambula kwa Mwoyo okunene mu byafaayo kwe nnasoma kwatandika n’ebiseera eby’okwatula n’okwenenya okw’amaanyi. Amaanyi ga Katonda gafulumizibwa oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’okulongoosebwa.”

“Buli lwe twatuukanga mu masaŋŋanzira mu kibiina, twasabanga okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lwe yayogeranga. Awo ne tugondera. Eyo ye ngeri yokka ey’okuzimba ekintu kyonna ekinaabeerera.”

“Okumanya Katonda n’okumumanyisa — kwe kuyitibwa kwa YWAM. Era okumanya Katonda, oteekwa okusaba.”

Ogwokubiri, twasaba Mukama aggye mu birowoozo byaffe buli kye tuteebereza n’endowooza ze tulina edda.
