Eyo ye ngeri yokka ey’okuzimba ekintu kyonna ekinaabeerera.” “Okumanya Katonda n’okumumanyisa — kwe kuyitibwa kwa YWAM. Era okumanya Katonda, oteekwa okusaba.”

fields.title: Derek Prince (1915 – 2003)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Derek Prince yazaalibwa e Bangalore, mu Buyindi, mu 1915, ku bazadde Abangereza. Yasomera mu Eton College ery’abeekitiibwa n’oluvannyuma mu Cambridge University, gye yalondebwa ku kifo eky’ekitiibwa eky’okunoonyereza mu King’s College olw’ekiwandiiko kye eky’obufirosoofo ng’alina emyaka abiri mu ena. Mu kiseera ekyo yeeyitanga muntu atakkiriza nti Katonda gy’ali.

Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri bwe lwabalukawo, Prince yeegatta ku Royal Army Medical Corps ng’omuntu agaana okulwana olw’omuntu we ow’omunda. Ng’okwegezaamu kw’obufirosoofo kwe yeewa yekka, yatandika okusoma Bayibuli. Mu 1941, bwe yali mu nkambi y’amagye, yafuna kye yayita “ekyamagero eky’omwoyo” — okusisinkana Yesu Kristo. Oluvannyuma yawandiika nti: “Okuva mu kusisinkana kuno nnafunamu ebintu bibiri: ekisooka, nti Yesu Kristo mulamu; ekyokubiri, nti Bayibuli kitabo kya mazima, ekikwatagana n’obulamu, era eky’omulembe guno. Ebintu bino byakyusa obulamu bwange bwonna.” Wiiki bbiri oluvannyuma yabatizibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

Enkya eyaddirira okukyuka kwe, omusajja eyali tasabangako mu bulamu bwe teyasobola kulekera awo kusaba. Yasindikibwa mu North Africa ne Palestine, era mu buweereza bwe obw’omu lutalo gye yasisinkana Lydia Christiansen, omukazi Omudaani eyali addukanya ennyumba y’abaana bamulekwa abawala munaana e Ramallah. Baafumbiriganwa mu 1946, era amangu ago Prince n’afuuka kitaawe w’abawala munaana. Yaleka ekifo kye mu Cambridge, n’atuuzibwa ng’omubuulizi, n’atandika ekkanisa ya Pentekoote mu London.

Okuva e London, Prince ne mukyala we baasenguka ne bagenda e Kenya, Prince gye yakulemberera essomero era n’atandika amakanisa. Oluvannyuma yagenda mu Amerika ne Canada, n’ekyasembayo n’abeera e Yerusaalemi mu 1981 — ekibuga kye yayagala ennyo olw’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi okwesigamye ku Bayibuli. Yawandiika ebitabo ebisoba mu ataano n’enjigiriza z’amaloboozi 600, ezaakyusibwa mu nnimi ezisoba mu 100. Yafiira mu Yerusaalemi nga 24 Ssebutemba 2003, ng’omu ku basomesa ba Bayibuli abaawulirwa ennyo mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Essaala esinga okwewuunyisa eyaddibwamu mu bulamu bwa Derek Prince kwe kukyuka kwe yennyini — okusisinkana Kristo omulamu kwe yali tasaba era nga takusuubira, ng’asoma Bayibuli yekka mu nkambi y’amagye ey’ekizikiza. Prince yali tanoonya Katonda. Yali asoma Bayibuli ng’omufirosoofo bw’asoma ekiwandiiko eky’edda. Naye Katonda n’ayingirawo, era omusajja eyagenda okwebaka nga takkiriza nti Katonda gy’ali yazuukuka ng’omukkiriza.

Prince yayogeranga nnyo ku jjajja we omukazi, eyamusabira n’obwesigwa mu myaka gye gyonna egy’obutaba na ddiini ku yunivasite. Yakkiriza ddala awatali kubuusabuusa nti emyaka gye egy’okumusabira ge gaateekateeka ettaka olw’okusisinkana okwo okw’ekitalo.

Oluvannyuma mu buweereza bwe, bwe yali omukulu w’essomero e Kenya ku nkomerero y’emyaka gya 1950, Prince yasaba abantu bazuukizibwe okuva mu bafu emirundi ebiri egy’enjawulo — era emirundi gyombi Katonda yaddamu. Ebyo bye yayitamu byongera okutegeera kwe ku buyinza abakkiriza bwe balina mu kusaba. Yamala obulamu bwe obwasigalawo ng’ayigiriza abakkiriza nti okusaba si mukolo gwa ddiini bugolo wabula kyakulwanyisa mu lutalo, kya kuwonya, era kkubo lya kugaziya Obwakabaka bwa Katonda ku nsi.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Abaefeso 6:17 – 18 (OLCB) — “N’ekigambo kya Katonda kibabeerere ekitala eky’Omwoyo, nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera.”

Abaruumi 8:34 (OLCB) — “Kristo Yesu yafa, kyokka okusinga byonna yazuukizibwa, era ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, ng’atwegayiririra.”

1 Timoseewo 2:1 (OLCB) — “Okusookera ddala, mbasaba, musabenga, mwegayirirenga, era mwebazenga Katonda ku lw’abantu bonna — era musabirenga bakabaka n’abafuzi abalala bonna.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okusaba tekuliiko kkomo. Ye bbomu yaffe ewenyuka okuva ku ssemazinga okudda ku ndala. Tusobola okugikasuka okuva wonna ne tugituusa wonna.”

“Abantu abafuga ddala ensi be abo abamanyi okusaba.”

“Amazima tegafunibwa ku buseere. Geetaagisa okuwaayo ebiseera bingi mu kusaba n’okusoma Ebyawandiikibwa, n’oluvannyuma okubikozesa mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku.”

“Ssaddaaka za mwoyo ki Katonda z’asuubira tuwaayo? Nga Yesu bwe yawaayo essaala n’okwegayirira mu bulamu bwe ku nsi, naffe bwe tutyo bwe tusaanidde. Bwe tuyiga okusaba, olwo tuba tusaanidde okufuga.”

“Bw’oba osaba mu kukkiriza, ogamba nti: “Okuddibwamu kunsemberedde emyaka kkumi okusinga bwe kwali lwe nnatandika okusaba.””

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Okubikkulirwa okunene okw’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala kye Kigambo kya Katonda. Era Ekigambo kya Katonda kijjudde ebisuubizo bya Katonda okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Katonda by’ayagala tebitukwekeddwa — byabikkulwa mu Byawandiikibwa. Saba ng’oyimiridde ku bisuubizo.”

“Katonda atuwadde ebyokulwanyisa eby’omwoyo bisatu ebikulu: Ekigambo kya Katonda, erinnya lya Yesu, n’omusaayi gwa Yesu. Ebyokulwanyisa bino tubikasuka nga tuyita mu kusaba, okutendereza, okubuulira, n’okuwa obujulirwa.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Tetuyinza kuweereza Katonda bulungi awatali Mwoyo Omutukuvu.”

“Okusiiba kukola ku biziyiza ebibiri ebinene eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu ebizimbibwa embala y’omubiri ey’omuntu — okwagala kw’omwoyo okw’obukakanyavu n’okwegomba kw’omubiri okutakoma okwagala okwesanyusa.”

“Ekiro nga sinnakyuka, saali mmanyi kusaba. Olunaku olwaddako saasobola kulekera awo kusaba. Ne bwe nnafunanga ekikopo ky’amazzi, nnalina okusooka okuyimirira ne neebaza Katonda olw’amazzi nga sinnaganywa. Okusaba kwali kufuuse kwa bulijjo ng’okussa omukka. Ogwo gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.”

fields.title: Timothy Keller (1950 – 2023)
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani?

Timothy James Keller yazaalibwa nga 23 Ssebutemba 1950 e Allentown, mu Pennsylvania. Yakulira mu maka ag’Abaluteri naye teyafuna kukkiriza okulamu okutuusa lwe yali ku Bucknell University ku nkomerero y’emyaka gya 1960, gye yafuukira Omukristaayo ng’ayita mu InterVarsity Christian Fellowship. Oluvannyuma yafuna diguli ya Master of Divinity ku Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary ne Doctor of Ministry ku Westminster Theological Seminary.

Bwe yamala okutuuzibwa mu Presbyterian Church in America, Keller yaweereza okumala emyaka mwenda ng’omusumba wa West Hopewell Presbyterian Church e Hopewell, mu Virginia, n’alyoka yeegatta ku basomesa ba Westminster Theological Seminary nga Pulofeesa w’Eby’eddiini eby’Enkola. Mu 1989, wadde abantu kumpi bonna baabagaana, ye ne mukyala we Kathy baasenguka ne bagenda e New York City, nga baddamu okuyitibwa okuva mu kkanisa yaabwe okutandika ekkanisa mu Manhattan.

Redeemer Presbyterian Church yatandika n’abantu abatasukka ataano nga bakuŋŋaanira mu kifo kye beewola.

Mu myaka kkumi yali ekuze okutuuka ku nkumi z’abasinza buli wiiki. Keller we yawummulira ng’omusumba omukulu mu 2017, Redeemer yasikiriza abantu abasoba mu 5,000 buli Ssande mu nkuŋŋaana nnyingi, yali etandise amakanisa agasoba mu kikumi mu kitundu kya New York, era yali efuuse ekyokulabirako ky’obuweereza bw’ekkanisa mu bibuga abasumba mu nsi yonna kye basoma.

Ebitabo bya Keller — omuli Ensonga lwaki Katonda Gy’ali, Katonda Agaba Awatali Kkomo, ne Okusaba: Okufuna Okutya n’Okusemberera Katonda — bitundiddwa obukadde n’obukadde era bikyusiddwa mu nnimi nnyingi nnyo. Yeegatta ku balala okutandika The Gospel Coalition ne Redeemer City to City, etendese abatandisi b’amakanisa mu bibuga ebinene ku buli ssemazinga. Mu 2020 Keller yazuulibwamu kookolo w’ensigo y’omu lubuto, gwe yayolekera n’okukkiriza okw’ekitalo n’obwerufu. Yafa nga 19 Mayi 2023, ku myaka 72.

Essaala Ennene Eyaddibwamu

Okutandika n’okukula kwa Redeemer Presbyterian Church mu Manhattan, kumpi mu kipimo kyonna, kuddibwamu kwa ssaala okw’ekitalo. Mu 1989, New York City teyalabibwanga ng’ettaka eggimu eri Obukristaayo obw’enjiri. Obuwangwa bwali bukontana nnyo n’eddiini, obulamu nga butambula mangu awatali kuwummula, era okunyigirizibwa kw’abantu ku abo abeewaayo eri eddiini nga kwa maanyi. Amakanisa agasinga agaagezaako okutandikibwa mu Manhattan gaali galemye oba gaasigala matono nnyo.

Keller ne mukyala we baasaba, ne basoma, ne beetegeka emyaka nga tebannagenda mu kibuga. Omulimu baagukwata n’obwegendereza mu by’eddiini n’amagezi ku buwangwa, nga beesiga Katonda okuggula emitima mu kyalabika ng’ettaka erisinga obukakanyavu mu Amerika. Katonda yaddamu mu bungi. Ekkanisa yakula okuva ku ataano okutuuka ku bitaano okutuuka ku nkumi ttaano — ng’esikiriza abakozi abavubuka, abayiiya, abasomi, n’abaabuusabuusanga abaali basisinkana Enjiri oboolyawo omulundi ogusooka.

Keller era yategeeza nti olutalo lwe ne kookolo, mu kifo ky’okusaanyaawo obulamu bwe obw’okusaba, lwabunnyikiza era ne lubukyusa. Yawandiika nti okwolekera okufa kwamuwaliriza okusirika mu maaso ga Katonda mu ngeri obuweereza bwe obw’emirimu emingi gye bwali butakkirizanga. Kookolo yamuyigiriza nti okusaba si kakodyo ka kufuna bivaamu wabula kusisinkana Katonda omulamu omwoyo mwe guzzibwa obuggya. Emyaka gye egy’enkomerero yagyolekera n’essanyu n’obwesige abangi abaamumanya bye baayita obumu ku bujulirwa obusinga amaanyi bwe baali balabye.

Ebyawandiikibwa Ebikulu

Matayo 6:6 (OLCB) — “Naye ggwe bw’obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n’osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by’omusabye.”

Abafiripi 4:6 – 7 (OLCB) — “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

Abaruumi 8:26 (OLCB) — “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka.”

Ebigambo Bye ku Kusaba

“Okusaba kwe kutya okw’ekitiibwa, okusemberera, okufuba — naye lye kkubo eridda mu mazima. Tewali kintu kikulu okusinga, oba ekizibu okusinga, oba ekigagga okusinga, oba ekikyusa obulamu okusinga. Tewali kintu kinene ng’okusaba.”

“Okusaba lwe luggi lwokka olw’okwetegeera ddala. Era lye kkubo eddene mwe tufunira enkyukakyuka ey’omunda — okuddamu okusengeka ebyo bye twagala. Okusaba y’engeri Katonda gy’atuwaamu ebintu bingi bye tutayinza kulowooza by’atutegekedde. Ye ngeri gye tumanyamu Katonda, engeri gye tukomekkereza nga tutwala Katonda nga Katonda. Okusaba kye kisumuluzo kya buli kimu kye twetaaga okukola n’okubeera mu bulamu.”

“Tumanyi nti Katonda anaatuddamu bwe tumukoowoola kubanga olunaku lumu olw’entiisa teyaddamu Yesu bwe yamukoowoola. Essaala za Yesu zaagaanibwa nga ffe abalina ebibi bwe tusaanidde, essaala zaffe zisobole okwanirizibwa nga ye bw’asaanidde.”

“Okusaba lye kkubo ery’okufuna obwesige obw’amaanyi nti Katonda akwata bulungi obulamu bwaffe — nti ebibi byaffe bijja kuvaamu ebirungi, ebirungi byaffe tebiyinza kututwalibwako, era ebisinga obulungi bikyajja.”

“N’olwekyo obutasaba si kumenya buli kiragiro kya ddiini kyokka — kwe kulemwa okutwala Katonda nga Katonda.”

Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

“Essaala zaffe zisaanidde okuva mu kwennyika mu Byawandiikibwa. Tusaanidde okwebbika mu nnyanja y’olulimi lwa Katonda, Bayibuli. Wuliriza, soma, lowooza, fumiitiriza, era weetegereze Ebyawandiikibwa okutuusa ng’omutima gwo gufunye eky’okuddamu — olwo okuddamu okwo, nga kuzzibwayo eri Katonda, kwe kusaba ddala.”

“Ekikulu mu kusaba si kuyiga kweyoleka, wabula kuyiga kuddamu Katonda. Okusaba okwa nnamaddala kutandika Katonda bw’asooka okwogera — mu Kigambo kye, okuyita mu Mwoyo we — naffe ne tuddamu.”

Okusaba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu

“Okusaba kwe kugenda mu maaso n’emboozi Katonda gye yatandika ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye ne mu kisa kye, ekyenkomerero efuuka okusisinkana naye mu bujjuvu.”

“Katonda ali mu Busatu yanditukoowoola okunyumya naye, kubanga ayagala okutugabanako essanyu ly’abaddenga nalyo bulijjo munda mu ye. Okusaba lye kkubo lyaffe ery’okuyingira mu ssanyu lya Katonda yennyini.”

“Okusaba kufuula eby’eddiini ebintu bye tuyitamu. Enjigiriza z’Ebyawandiikibwa zirina okufuuka amafuta g’okusaba, oba zijja kusigala kumanya kwa mu mutwe kwokka. Omwoyo bw’akwata amazima n’agassa mu kusaba, omuliro gukoleezebwa.”
fields.body_text: Yali Ani? Timothy James Keller yazaalibwa nga 23 Ssebutemba 1950 e Allentown, mu Pennsylvania. Yakulira mu maka ag’Abaluteri naye teyafuna kukkiriza okulamu okutuusa lwe yali ku Bucknell University ku nkomerero y’emyaka gya 1960, gye yafuukira Omukristaayo ng’ayita mu InterVarsity Christian Fellowship. Oluvannyuma yafuna diguli ya Master of Divinity ku Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary ne Doctor of Ministry ku Westminster Theological Seminary. Bwe yamala okutuuzibwa mu Presbyterian Church in America, Keller yaweereza okumala emyaka mwenda ng’omusumba wa West Hopewell Presbyterian Church e Hopewell, mu Virginia, n’alyoka yeegatta ku basomesa ba Westminster Theological Seminary nga Pulofeesa w’Eby’eddiini eby’Enkola. Mu 1989, wadde abantu kumpi bonna baabagaana, ye ne mukyala we Kathy baasenguka ne bagenda e New York City, nga baddamu okuyitibwa okuva mu kkanisa yaabwe okutandika ekkanisa mu Manhattan. Redeemer Presbyterian Church yatandika n’abantu abatasukka ataano nga bakuŋŋaanira mu kifo kye beewola. Mu myaka kkumi yali ekuze okutuuka ku nkumi z’abasinza buli wiiki. Keller we yawummulira ng’omusumba omukulu mu 2017, Redeemer yasikiriza abantu abasoba mu 5,000 buli Ssande mu nkuŋŋaana nnyingi, yali etandise amakanisa agasoba mu kikumi mu kitundu kya New York, era yali efuuse ekyokulabirako ky’obuweereza bw’ekkanisa mu bibuga abasumba mu nsi yonna kye basoma. Ebitabo bya Keller — omuli Ensonga lwaki Katonda Gy’ali, Katonda Agaba Awatali Kkomo, ne Okusaba: Okufuna Okutya n’Okusemberera Katonda — bitundiddwa obukadde n’obukadde era bikyusiddwa mu nnimi nnyingi nnyo. Yeegatta ku balala okutandika The Gospel Coalition ne Redeemer City to City, etendese abatandisi b’amakanisa mu bibuga ebinene ku buli ssemazinga. Mu 2020 Keller yazuulibwamu kookolo w’ensigo y’omu lubuto, gwe yayolekera n’okukkiriza okw’ekitalo n’obwerufu. Yafa nga 19 Mayi 2023, ku myaka 72. fields.title: Okufundikira
fields.body_html:
Abasajja Bano Kye Batulekedde

Kaakano otambudde mu bulamu bw’abasajja kkumi na bataano abaasabanga. Baava mu byasa eby’enjawulo, ku ssemazinga ez’enjawulo, mu madiini ag’enjawulo, ne mu mbeera ez’enjawulo. Abamu baali bayivu ate abalala nga tebaasoma. Abamu baasumba amakanisa amanene ate abalala ne baweereza nga tebamanyiddwa.

Abamu mannya gaabwe matiikirivu mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa ate abalala bamanyiddwa abo bokka abanoonyereza ennyo ku bazira b’okukkiriza abakwekeddwa. Naye buli omu ku bo yazuula amazima ge gamu: nti okusaba si mulimu gumu ku mingi, wabula ye musingi buli buweereza obwa nnamaddala kwe buzimbibwa.

Laba okusaba kye kwakola mu bulamu bwabwe. Kwaleeta okuzuukuka kitaawe wa Andrew Murray kwe yali asabidde okumala emyaka egisoba mu amakumi asatu. Kwajjuza D. L. Moody amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku luguudo lw’e New York ne kumusindika okubuulira obukadde n’obukadde. Kwakyusa ensonga z’Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri nga kuyita mu kibinja ekitono eky’abeegayirizi mu Ttendekero lya Bayibuli e Wales. Kwatandika ekkanisa mu kibuga ekisinga obuzibu mu Amerika ne kugikuza okutuuka ku bantu enkumi ttaano. Kwaleeta enkuba ku kizinga eky’ewala mu China abagoberezi b’ekifaananyi bwe baasoomooza Katonda omulamu. Kwakyusa omuyivu wa Cambridge eyali takkiriza nti Katonda gy’ali okuyita mu Bayibuli gye yasomera yekka mu nkambi y’amagye. Kwafuula ekibiina ekyali kiggwaawo eky’abantu kkumi mu nsenyi za Canada okubeera ekkanisa eyazaala amakanisa amalala amakumi asatu mu munaana.

Okusaba kukola. Si ng’eddagala ery’obulogo. Si ng’akakodyo. Si ng’omulimu gw’eddiini ogukolebwa okufuna ekisa kya Katonda. Okusaba kukola kubanga Katonda wa ddala, Katonda ali wano, Katonda awuliriza, era Katonda wa maanyi. Okusaba kukola kubanga Yesu Kristo ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Kitaffe, ng’abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okutuwolereza (Abaebbulaniya 7:25). Okusaba kukola kubanga Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu ffe “atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe” era “atwegayiririra n’okusinda okutayogerekeka” (Abaruumi 8:26, OLCB). Bwe tusaba, tetwogera mu bbanga eryereere. Twogera n’Omutonzi era Omuwanirizi w’obwengula bwonna, Oyo akwata buli ggwanga mu kibatu kye, Oyo eyatwagala n’atuma Omwana we omu yekka okutufiirira.

Ekiyungo Kye Bafaanaganya

Bwe tutunuulira abasajja bano kkumi na bataano wamu, tulaba enkola eziwerako ezisaanidde okulambulwa.

Ekisooka: bonna baali basajja ba Kigambo. Tewali n’omu ku bo eyasaba ng’ayawukana ku Byawandiikibwa.

Andrew Murray yalemerako nti Ekigambo n’Omwoyo birina okugattibwa mu kusaba. E. M. Bounds yalangirira nti Ekigambo kya Katonda “y’emmere eriisa okusaba n’ekukuza amaanyi.” A. R .

Torrey yayigiriza nti “okusaba okuzaalibwa mu kufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda kwe kusaba okulinnya waggulu mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo, okutuuka ku matu ga Katonda ag’okuwuliriza.” Timothy Keller yannyonnyola okusaba ng’“okugenda mu maaso n’emboozi Katonda gye yatandika ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye.” Eri abasajja bonna kkumi na bataano, Bayibuli teyali yawufu ku kusaba — yali lulimi lw’okusaba, amafuta g’okusaba, era omusingi gw’okusaba.

Ekyokubiri: bonna baali basajja abeesiga Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tebeesiga bwogezi bwabwe, kusoma kwabwe okw’eby’eddiini, busobozi bwabwe obw’okutegeka, wadde ebirabo byabwe eby’obuzaaliranwa. Spurgeon yagamba nti, “Okusaba kitonde kya Mwoyo Omutukuvu.” Moody yasaba okutuusa Katonda lwe yajja n’amujjula nnyo ku luguudo lw’e New York. Torrey yayigiriza nti okuyingira mu maaso ga Katonda kisoboka olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gokka. Finney yawulira Omwoyo ng’amukkako “mu mayengo ag’okwagala okukulukuta.” Rees Howells yamala obuweereza bwe bwonna ng’alungamizibwa butereevu era ng’afukiddwako amafuta g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Eri abasajja bano bonna, Omwoyo Omutukuvu teyali njigiriza ya kukubaganyako birowoozo wabula Omuntu gwe beesigamako.

Ekyokusatu: bonna baali basajja abaasasula omuwendo. Okusaba si kwangu. Tekubaawo mu ssaawa ennungi. Kutwala obudde, amaanyi, otulo, okwesiima, n’amalala. E. M. Bounds yazuukukanga ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro buli lunaku okumala emyaka amakumi asatu. Rees Howells n’ekibiina kye baasabanga buli kawungeezi okutuusa mu ttumbi mu myaka gy’olutalo egyasinga obuzibu. Andrew Murray yafiirwa eddoboozi lye okumala emyaka ebiri mu kyoto ky’okwewaayo.

Watchman Nee yamala emyaka amakumi abiri mu kkomera. Jonathan Edwards yagobwa ekibiina kye yennyini. Charles Finney yasekererwa era n’awakanyizibwa. Derek Prince yaleka omulimu gw’obuyivu ogwali gumutunuulira obulungi. Timothy Keller yayolekera kookolo ng’okusaba kye kyokulwanyisa kye kyokka. Tewali n’omu ku bo eyatugamba nti okusaba kwangu. Baatugamba nti kusaanira.

Ekyokuna: bonna baali basajja essaala zaabwe ezaabawangaalako. Essaala za kitaawe wa Andrew Murray olw’okuzuukuka zaaddibwamu mu 1860, emyaka amakumi nga zaatandika. Essaala ya E. M. Bounds olw’Ekkanisa esaba yaddibwamu okuyita mu bitabo bye omunaana ku kusaba, musanvu ku byo nga byafulumizibwa ng’amaze okufa. Rees Howells yeegayiririra Eggwanga lya Isirayiri nga terinnabaawo, era eggwanga ne lizaalibwa buto mu 1948, emyaka ebiri nga tannafa. Loren Cunningham yafuna okwolesebwa mu kusaba mu 1956 kwe yamala emyaka nkaaga mu musanvu ng’alaba nga kutuukirira. Billy Graham yasabira emyoyo egyabula mu buli lukuŋŋaana lw’enjiri, era ebibala by’essaala ezo byeyongera okubuna mu bantu kinnoomu, amaka, n’ebitundu nga buli lukuŋŋaana luwedde dda. Okusaba tekukoma ku bulamu bw’oyo asaba. Kutuuka mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.

Ekigambo eri Abasumba Wonna

Oweereza Katonda mu kiseera ekikulu ennyo mu byafaayo bye, buli w’akuteeka. Ekkanisa ezimbiddwa ku ssaddaaka z’abeesigwa mu buli mulembe ne mu buli nsi. Abaminsani abajja mu Uganda mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda baasasula omuwendo munene nnyo. Abajulizi ba Uganda baafa nga erinnya lya Kristo liri ku mimwa gyabwe. Okuzuukuka okw’Obuvanjuba bwa Afirika okw’ekyasa eky’amakumi abiri kwasindika amayengo g’amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu Uganda n’okusingawo. Buli w’otunuulira mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa, oli musika w’obusika obwo bwennyini obw’okusaba.

Naye obusika obw’edda tebumala. Buli mulembe gulina okusisinkana Katonda buggya. Omuliro ku kyoto gulina okuzzibwa obuggya buli nkya. Era mu mulembe gwo, okusoomoozebwa kunene: obwavu n’okubonaabona mu bantu b’oweereza, okusasika kw’amaka, okunyigirizibwa kw’eby’obufuzi, enjigiriza ez’obulimba, olutalo olw’omwoyo, okusikirizibwa obugagga n’okwegomba okw’obuntu. Obulamu bw’okusaba obuzito era obutakoma bwokka bwe bujja okukusobozesa okwolekera okusoomoozebwa kuno n’okukulembera ekibiina kyo okukuyitamu.

Era oteekeddwa mu kifo eky’okukwata ku bantu ewala ennyo okusukka bbugwe zo. Mu nsi yonna, amakanisa agaali gaaweebwanga obuminsani gafuuse amakanisa agasindika, nga gayimusa abakulembeze ab’ekitalo, ababuulizi, n’ababuulizi b’enjiri — era amakanisa ga Afirika ge gamu ku agasinga okuba n’amaanyi mu go. Bw’ozimba obulamu bwo obw’okusaba, toweereza kibiina kyo kyokka — ozimba emisingi gy’omulimu gw’Ekkanisa mu nsi yonna.

Abasajja kkumi na bataano abali mu kitabo kino tebaali bantu basukkulumye ku bantu. Baali bantu ba bulijjo abakkiriza ekigambo kya Katonda. Baasaba kubanga baakkiriza nti Katonda awulira. Baagumiikiriza kubanga baakkiriza nti Katonda addamu. Baawaayo okwesiima n’obwangu kubanga baakkiriza nti okusaba kusinga omuwendo buli kintu ekirala kye bandikoze. Buli omu ku bo yandikugambye leero nti: “Osobola okukikola. Oteekwa okukikola. Ensi gy’ogezaako okutuukako ekulindiridde osabe.”

OKUKOOWOOLA OKUKOLA Ekiragiro eri Abasumba n’Abasomesa Wonna

Ekitabo kino tekigendereddwa kutuula ku sseefu. Kigendereddwa kukufukamiza. Bw’oggala empapula zino, ekibuuzo si nti “Kiki kye nnayize?” wabula nti “Kiki kye nnaakola?”

Wano waliwo ebintu musanvu eby’omugaso by’oyinza okweyama okukola okusinziira ku by’osomye: 1. Teekawo Ekiseera eky’Okusaba Buli Lunaku Buli musajja mu kitabo kino yateekangawo ekiseera ekyenjawulo eky’okusaba. Abamu baasabanga essaawa nnyingi buli nkya.

Bonna baali bagenderera era nga bakwata empisa. Londa ekiseera — ka zibe dakiika amakumi asatu ku makya ennyo, essaawa emu mu ttuntu, oba okutunula akawungeezi — era okikuume. Tegeeza ab’omu maka go. Kikuume obutatataaganyizibwa. Era kikuume ne ku nnaku z’owulira nga toyagala kusaba, kubanga ezo emirundi mingi ze nnaku essaala yo mw’esinga okuba ey’omugaso.

2. Okusaba Kwo Kwesigame ku Byawandiikibwa

Bw’osaba, jjangu ne Bayibuli yo. Sooka osome ekitundu. Leka Katonda ayogere nga tonnayogera.

Zzaayo eri Katonda ebisuubizo bye mu kusaba. Leka ebigambo bya Zabbuli bifuuke ebigambo byo. Leka essaala za Pawulo mu Abaefeso 1 ne 3 zikulungamye mu ngeri gy’osabiramu ekibiina kyo. Leka essaala ennene eza Bayibuli — eza Musa, Danyeri, Nekkemiya, Yesu — zikuyigirize okusaba bwe kufaanana nga kunyeenya eggulu.

3. Saba Okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu

Saba Katonda buli lunaku akujjuze buggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Si lwa birabo n’amaanyi byokka — wadde nga bya ddala era bikulu — wabula embala ya Kristo ekolebwe mu ggwe. Saba Omwoyo akulage eky’okusabira, akuwe emigugu egiri ku mutima gwa Katonda, era yeegayiririre ng’ayita mu ggwe ku lw’ebyo ebisinga obukulu eri Katonda.

4. Sabira Ekibiina Kyo ng’Oyita Amannya

Funa olukalala lw’abantu b’omu kibiina kyo olusabire bulijjo. Sabira obufumbo bwabwe, abaana baabwe, emirimu gyabwe, ebizibu byabwe, n’okukkiriza kwabwe. Abantu bwe bakuleetera ebyokusabira, biwandiike era olondoole. Ekibiina kyo kitegeere nti obasabira mu mannya gaabwe. Kino kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga amaanyi omusumba by’ayinza okukola.

5. Zimba Empisa y’Okusaba mu Kkanisa Yo

Spurgeon yagamba nti olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olw’akawungeezi ku Bbalaza lye lyali yingini ya buli kimu Metropolitan Tabernacle kye yatuukako. Ekibiina ky’okusaba ekya Rees Howells kyakuŋŋaananga buli kawungeezi. Obulamu bw’okusaba obw’ekibiina kyo buli butya? Teekawo olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olwa bulijjo. Yigiriza ku kusaba ng’oli ku kituuti. Tegeeza mu lwatu essaala ezaddiddwamu okuzimba okukkiriza. Yita abakadde n’abadiikoni bo musabire wamu nga buli lukuŋŋaana terunnatandika. Okusaba kubeere empewo ekkanisa yo gy’essa.

6. Funa Munno mu Kusaba oba Beera Munne

Kumpi buli musajja mu kitabo kino yalina abantu abaasabanga naye era abaamusabiranga. Charles Finney yalina Taata Nash. Loren Cunningham yalina ekibiina ky’abeegayirizi ba YWAM. Henry Blackaby yalina ekibinja ky’abasumba b’e Saskatoon abaasabira wamu okumala emyaka ebiri okuzuukuka nga tekunnajja. Funa abasumba oba abakadde abalala omu oba babiri abanaakkiriza okusaba naawe bulijjo. Era musabirenga buli omu ku munne mu ngeri entuufu, mu bwesimbu, era awatali kulekulira.

7. Weegayiririre Eggwanga Lyo n’Amawanga

Essaala zo tezikoma ku kibiina kyo. Katonda gw’osaba ye Katonda w’amawanga. Sabira eggwanga lyo — abakulembeze baalyo, amaka gaalyo, amasomero gaalyo, amakanisa gaalyo, abaminsani baalyo.

Sabira ssemazinga wo. Sabira abantu b’ensi abatannatuukibwako Njiri. Sabira okujja kw’Obwakabaka bwa Katonda mu buli ggwanga. Nga Rees Howells bwe yazuula, okusaba kugazi ng’omutima gwa Katonda.

Ekigambo eky’Enkomerero

Andrew Murray yawandiika nti: “Omuntu akunga ekkanisa ey’Ekikristaayo okusaba ajja kuwaayo ekirabo ekisinga obunene eri okubuulira ensi yonna enjiri mu byafaayo.”

E. M. Bounds yalangirira nti: “Okutwetooloola waliwo ensi ebuze mu kibi, waggulu waffe waliwo Katonda ayagala era asobola okulokola; ffe tulina okuzimba olutindo olugatta eggulu n’ensi, era okusaba kye kikozesebwa eky’amaanyi ekikola omulimu ogwo.”

Timothy Keller yafundikira nti: “Tewali kintu kinene ng’okusaba.”

Abasajja bano baali batuufu. Okusaba gwe mulimu ogusinga obunene. Kye kintu ekisinga obukulu ky’onookola leero, n’enkya, ne buli lunaku olw’obuweereza bwo. Kye kifuula buli kintu ekirala ky’okola okubeera ekiramu n’amaanyi ga Katonda. Era kikuli kumpi kaakano.

N’olwekyo ggala ekitabo kino. Funa ekifo ekisirifu. Bikkula Bayibuli yo. Era saba. Si lwakuba nti olina okukikola.

Wabula kubanga Katonda wa Andrew Murray ne Charles Spurgeon ne Watchman Nee ne D. L. Moody n’abalala bonna — Katonda oyo yennyini — akulindiridde okukusisinkana eyo.

“Buli kye munaasabanga nga mukkiriza, munaakiweebwanga.”

Matayo 21:22 (OLCB)

Kwaleeta okuzuukuka kitaawe wa Andrew Murray kwe yali asabidde okumala emyaka egisoba mu amakumi asatu. Kwajjuza D. L. Moody amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku luguudo lw’e New York ne kumusindika okubuulira obukadde n’obukadde. Kwakyusa ensonga z’Olutalo olw’Ensi Yonna olw’Okubiri nga kuyita mu kibinja ekitono eky’abeegayirizi mu Ttendekero lya Bayibuli e Wales. Kwatandika ekkanisa mu kibuga ekisinga obuzibu mu Amerika ne kugikuza okutuuka ku bantu enkumi ttaano. Kwaleeta enkuba ku kizinga eky’ewala mu China abagoberezi b’ekifaananyi bwe baasoomooza Katonda omulamu. Kwakyusa omuyivu wa Cambridge eyali takkiriza nti Katonda gy’ali okuyita mu Bayibuli gye yasomera yekka mu nkambi y’amagye. Kwafuula ekibiina ekyali kiggwaawo eky’abantu kkumi mu nsenyi za Canada okubeera ekkanisa eyazaala amakanisa amalala amakumi asatu mu munaana. Okusaba kukola. Si ng’eddagala ery’obulogo. Si ng’akakodyo. Si ng’omulimu gw’eddiini ogukolebwa okufuna ekisa kya Katonda. Okusaba kukola kubanga Katonda wa ddala, Katonda ali wano, Katonda awuliriza, era Katonda wa maanyi. Tewali n’omu ku bo eyasaba ng’ayawukana ku Byawandiikibwa. Andrew Murray yalemerako nti Ekigambo n’Omwoyo birina okugattibwa mu kusaba. E. M. Bounds yalangirira nti Ekigambo kya Katonda “y’emmere eriisa okusaba n’ekukuza amaanyi.” A. R . Torrey yayigiriza nti “okusaba okuzaalibwa mu kufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda kwe kusaba okulinnya waggulu mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo, okutuuka ku matu ga Katonda ag’okuwuliriza.” Timothy Keller yannyonnyola okusaba ng’“okugenda mu maaso n’emboozi Katonda gye yatandika ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye.” Eri abasajja bonna kkumi na bataano, Bayibuli teyali yawufu ku kusaba — yali lulimi lw’okusaba, amafuta g’okusaba, era omusingi gw’okusaba.
